name: Volatile Diet
description: You have survived on a diet most would consider exotic. You gain +1 Resilience and cannot become Poisoned or Diseased from consuming a substance.

name: The Bonds of Truth
description: The Dragonkind are known for honorbound honesty and can easily pick out a lie. Gain +2 Insight, but telling a lie or breaking a promise causes you to take 1d12 Psychic Damage.

name: Considerate Diplomats
description: The Dragonkind are used to treating with others and learning the tongues of other cultures. Gain +1 Persuasion and Learn a non-Magical Language.

name: Culture of Magic
description: The Dragonkind study the Arcane at a young age. Gain +1 Spell Damage and +1 Arcanum.

name: Trophy Hunters
description: The Dragonkind protect their homelands, slaying beasts and taking trophies. You can adorn Armor and Weapons by applying permanent Augments to them after they are Crafted without requiring a Check.

name: Draconic Magic
description: Dragonkind celebrate the magic gifted to them by their ancient ancestors. Learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Draconic Spells

name: Blessing of the Great Wyrm
description: Those who have spent time with the Dragonkind gain an ancient blessing. Gain +2 Elemental Mitigation and +2 Arcane Mitigation.

name: Trained Hunters
description: Lizardmen are brought up from a young age hunting in harsh conditions and require keen senses and skills. Gain +1 Wilderness and +1 Search.

name: Meat on a Stick
description: Cooking is an essential part of Lizardman culture, gaining +1 Cooking. When you Craft a Basic Meal using 2 Meat, you produce an Improved Meal instead of a Basic one.

name: Steppe Brawlers
description: The Lizardmen hunt massive Creatures at a distance with long spears and ranged weapons. Gain +1 Damage with Piercing and Ranged Weapons.

name: Grand Migrations
description: The Lizardmen are migratory and are well equipped to deal with the wilderness. You gain +2 Fire and Cold Mitigation and get credit for a Favorable Rest when sleeping outside.

name: Free Action : Savage Fighting
description: When you miss with a Melee Attack, you make a quick and brutal Unarmed Attack against the same Target with a 1d4 Attack Penalty but an additional 2d6 damage.

name: Stalking
description: The Lizardmen are trained at an early age to move both quickly and quietly to set up ambushes. Gain +1 Initiative, +1 Stealth and +1 Movement Speed.

name: Vsthrii Honor Scout
description: The highest honor in the Lizardmen culture is being appointed an Honor Scout after proving yourself in the great hunt. Gain +1 Search, +1 Athletics, and +1 Attack with Ranged Weapons.

name: Isolationist
description: The Orycotal culture is one of both suspicion and superstition. Gain +1 Initiative and +1 Insight

name: Encouraged Curiousity
description: The Orycotal are taught that the most curious are often the most rewarded. You gain +1 Search and become Good at either the Search or Initiative Skill

name: Craft : Improved Accessory
description: The Orycotal appreciate the beauty and power of accessories like rings. When you Craft an Accessory, it has an extra Infusion Slot.

name: Reaction : Trained against Darkness
description: In response to taking Dark Damage, reduce the amount by double your Level. If all the Dark Damage was Mitigated, gain Temporary Health equal to your Level until the end of your next turn.

name: Emnity of the Fey
description: Certain factions within the Orycotal culture have an extreme distrust of the Fey and prepare to face them at every turn. Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Psychic Mitigation.

name: Ally of the Fey
description: Certain factions within  the Orycotal culture have allied themselves with the Fey. You Learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Fey Magic Spells.

name: Culture of Tranquility
description: The Orycotal are taught not to act in anger. Through learning and practice, you have become Immune to the Maddened Condition.

name: One Purpose
description: Orcish culture is one of loyalty and perserverance to a greater cause. Gain +1 Resilience and +1 Initiative.

name: Faithless
description: The Orcish cultures have long since given up worshipping the Gods and insulate themselves from the temptations they offer. Gain +3 Dark and +3 Divine Mitigation.

name: The Old Ways
description: The Orcish culture still has small remnants of those who have dedicated themselves to shamanism. Gain 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Druidic Spells.

name: Body and Mind
description: Orcish culture values a diverse eduction so that all who share in their lifestyle can find the correct path. Gain +1 Athletics and +1 Academics.

name: Trained by the Thok-Ro
description: You have training with the Thok-Ro Warriors. Gain +1 Block with Shields and +1 Damage with Slashing Weapons.

name: Craft : Refining
description: The Orcish culture cherishes perfection and perfect metalwork. Once per executing a Recipe that requires an Ingot and before you attempt your Crafting Check, your next Check counts as an Overcraft on a Dice Roll of 9 or higher.

name: Orcish Industry
description: The Orcish culture believes in cross-trained artisans to secure their future. Gain +1 Smithing, +1 Ammocraft, +1 Alchemy and +1 Engineering.

name: Whimsical Engineering
description: Gnomish cultures take great pride in their tinkering with both magic and machines. Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Engineering

name: Merchants
description: Gnomish cultures are famous for their merchants and making trades. Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Insight. Gain an Additional 1d4 Persuasion when making a deal that involves trade or procuring services for money.

name: Polite
description: Gnomish cultures preach both patience and speaking quietly, always staying focused and never disturbing their elders. Gain +1 Stealth and +1 Concentration.

name: Evasion Training
description: Gnomish cultures tend to start avoidance training at a young age to resist the many dangers in their homeland. Gain +1 Dodge and +1 Initiative.

name: Higher Education
description: Gnomish culture values expertise in a single subject rather than broad learning. Become Good at one Knowledge Skill and the learn the Arcanascript Language.

name: Gnomish Ingenuity
description: Gnomish cultures are capable and clever engineers and take great pride in their creations. Gain +1 Engineering and +1 Ammocraft. Additionally, Ranged Weapons that you produce have a +1 Damage Bonus and +2 Maximum Range.

name: Conduit Attunement
description: Gnomish cultures value the bonds between a Conduit and its owner and are taught how to precicely attune to them. When you bond with a Conduit, start with a Common Bond and gain +6 Power and +6 Power Regen.

name: Heritage of Will
description: Humans have a willful culture, and become endurant and resistant to magic. Gain +1 Resistance and +1 Resilience

name: Pride in Diversity
description: Humans have many sub-cultures and intermingle with other ancestries and culture groups. Gain +1 Persuasion and learn a non-Magical Language.

name: Paladin Orders
description: Human cultures are impacted heavily by faith, often bordering on fanaticism. Learn 2 Beginner and 2 Novice Divine Spells and gain +1 Damage with Slashing Weapons.

name: Adaptive
description: Human culture demands adaptation to thrive. Gain +1 Elemental Mitigation, +1 Arcane Mitigation and +1 Psychic Mitigation

name: Folk Hero
description: Human cultures place heroes on pedestals so that others seek to replicate their glory. Gain +1 Block to all shields and +1 Physical Mitigation

name: Corrupted by Temptation
description: Zealotry is always a danger within Human culture, and can lead to dangerous beliefs. Learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Fiend Spell and gain +2 Divine Mitigation.

name: Free Action : Glorykill
description: Whenever you land a killing blow on a Creature your Level or higher, you can grant an allied player a Heroic Action

name: Giant Heritage
description: Living within the Half Giant culture requires toughness as the weak do not survive. Gain +2 Health and +1 Damage on Melee Attacks.

name: Born of Winter
description: The Half Giant culture thrives in the coldest regions. Gain +4 Cold Mitigation. Additionally, when you Craft any piece of Light Armor, it gains +1 Cold Mitigation.

name: Fearless
description: The Half Giant culture do not accept weakness within their clans. Gain Immunity to the Afraid Condition

name: Free Action : Body over Mind
description: Until the end of your next turn, you ignore the effects of the Wounded, Exhausted, Poisoned and Bleeding Conditions.

name: Beast Alliances
description: Half Giant cultures rely on domesticating Beasts to survive in their harsh climates. Gain +1 Animals and you can tame Beasts that are 2 Levels over your Taming Threshold.

name: Honor in Grit
description: The Half Giant cultures value grit above all. Gain +1 Strength and +1 Resilience.

name: Nomads
description: Individuals within the Half Giant culture spend their lives migrating across vast plains of frost. Gain +1 Wilderness, +1 Movement Speed and +1 Athletics.

name: Culture of Festivals
description: The Goblin culture is happy to celebrate even minor occassions. Gain +1 Persuasion and Gain +1 Performance

name: Studier of Artifacts
description: You gain +1 Academics and +1 Runecarving. You gain a 1d4 Bonus to Checks when attempting to deduce the origin of an Object or Structure.

name: Magical Builders
description: The masons and architects in the Goblin culture build and design with magic. Learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Transmutation Spells.

name: Appreciation for the Arts
description: The Goblin culture is enamored by beauty. You can spend a minute admiring either an artifact, a piece of art or architecture to borrow inspiration. The object in question must be at least 100 years old, valued over 100 gold and something that has not been the target of this ability in the past. If you are successfully inspired, you gain a 1d4 Bonus to Performance Checks for the rest of the day and a 1d4 Bonus to your next Craft Check. If the 1d4 on the Craft Check results in a 4, add 1 Overcraft to the Object.

name: Meritocracy
description: Those who excel in crafting beautiful objects are the ones who advance within the Goblin society. Gain +1 to all Crafting Skills.

name: Those Who Covet
description: With a culture defined by such beautiful and expensive art, there are those who make ends meet by taking. Gain +1 Stealth and +1 Thievery

name: Trained in Magic
description: The elite of Goblin society are trained in powerful magic. Gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Elven Striders
description: Elven culture requires quick feet and decision making to survive their harsh homeland. Gain +1 Movement Speed and +1 Initiative.

name: Action : Bladedancing
description: As part of the Elven culture, you have perfected the Bladedancer form. Make an Attack with a Slashing Weapon and gain a 1d4 Bonus to Dodge Checks until the start of your next turn.

name: Naturopathy
description: Living in the wilderness has caused a more homegrown focus on healing. Gain +1 Alchemy and +1 Medicine.

name: Astral Navigators
description: The Elven culture are trained to move with the guidance of celestial bodies and cannot get lost while under the stars. Gain +1 Search and +1 Wilderness.

name: Gift from the Stars
description: Those who grow up within the Elven culture are exposed to the magic of the stars. You Learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Level Cosmic Spells and gain +2 Arcane Mitigation.

name: Efficient Archery
description: The Elven culture teaches bowmanship at a young age. Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Ranged Weapons. Additionally, Basic Ammunition you make gains 1 Infusion Slot.

name: Elven Woads
description: Cumbersome armor is rare within Elven Society and most fight with little in the way of protection, often opting to show painted skin. Gain +2 Dodge while not wearing armor.

name: Wraps of the Arah-Ka
description: The Arah-Ka wear leather wraps that protect them from the harsh desert. Gain +1 Physical Mitigation when wearing Light Armor.

name: Path of the Sunscholar
description: The sunscholars dedicate themselves to the flame and finding the knowledge within. Learn 2 Beginner and Novice Pyromancy Spells and gain +1 Academics

name: Path of the Sundancer
description: The sundancers achieve ultimate form to attain knowledge. Gain +1 Acrobatics and +1 Athletics

name: The Harsh Desert
description: The Arah-Ka society functions best during the warm days in the desert, but they have learned to endure the long, cold nights. Gain +3 Cold Mitigation and +1 Resilience.

name: Bloodless Weaponry
description: The Arah-ka society train with weapons that do not scar skin as to not desecrate themselves. Gain +1 Attack and Damage on Bludgeoning Weapons and Unarmed Attacks.

name: Legacy of Knowledge
description: Many within the Arah-Ka culture dedicate themselves to continued learning and spellcraft. Gain +1 Scribing and become Good at one Knowledge Skill.

name: Action : Ritual Dagger
description: You perform the ultimate offense in the Arah-Ka culture and make an Attack with a Light 1-Handed Piercing Weapon made of glass, causing the Target to gain the Bleeding Condition. Add an additional 1d10 Damage to any Physical Damage you do while the Target has the Bleeding Condition on it.

name: Foolishly Brave
description: The Kobold culture is built upon banding together and being fearless in the face of certain death. While there are 2 or more Allies within 6 Units, you are Immune to being Afraid.

name: Natural Throwing Arm
description: Often short of weaponry to support such a large population, it is commonplace in the Kobold culture to perfect accurate throwing to deter predators. Small Objects that you throw and Throwing Ammunition deal an additional 2 Damage and are upgraded to Critical Hits on a True Hit.

name: Good with Traps
description: The Kobold culture typically employs traps to protect their property and hard-won treasure. Gain +1 Thievery and +1 Engineering

name: Action : Skitterstrike
description: You move up to Half your Movement Speed. For every Creature you come within 1 Unit of, you can make an Attack with a Light or Unarmed Weapon.

name: The Draconic Legacy
description: The kobold culture was shaped by the dragons of old, and some knowledge of that magic still remains. Gain 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Draconic Spells.

name: Cavedwellers
description: Kobold societies are built underground, and those who dwell within learn to listen for subtle sounds to detect enemies. You gain +1 Search and Tremorsense up to 6 Units.

name: Free Action : Reckless Abandon
description: You dedicate yourself to all out aggression against a Creature that is two sizes or more larger than you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a 1d4 Bonus to Attacks against this Creature but suffer a 1d4 Penalty to all Defense Checks against them.

name: The Eternal Hunt
description: The Gnollish culture is built upon the concept of the great, unending hunt. Gain +1 Wilderness and +1 Resilience

name: Never Complacent
description: Gnolls are trained to keep tabs on their surroundings, as well as sleep lightly. You always have the Alerted Condition without requiring your Focus, even when Unconscious or Sleeping.

name: Oracle Guidance
description: The Gnollish culture is guided by mysterious oracles, and interpreting signs is an important facet of life. Gain +1 Insight and 1 Luck Dice.

name: Trained Hunters
description: Becoming a hunter is something nearly all are expected do within Gnollish society as a right of passage. Gain +1 Stealth, +1 Initiative and +1 Insight.

name: Path of the Shaman
description: Many within the Gnollish culture rely on shamanism for healing. Gain +1 Alchemy, +1 Medicine, and Learn 2 Beginner and 2 Novice Druidic Spells.

name: Pack Fighter
description: The Gnollish culture is based on moving in large packs and hunting together. Once per turn, you can add a 1d4 Bonus to an Attack Roll when at least 2 Allies are within 4 Units of you.

name: Action [Daily] : Mark of the Hunt
description: You Mark a target you can see within 30 Units lasting until the end of a Full Rest. You gain +2 Movement Speed towards your target and deal an extra 1d10 Damage whenever you deal Physical Damage to them.

name: Unrelenting
description: The Minotaur culture is one where things change slowly, if at all, giving them a reputation of legendary stubborness. Gain +1 Resilience and +1 Strength

name: Reaction : Blood Fury
description: In response to being the Target of a True Hit that deals Physical Damage, you enter a Blood Fury until you make your next Melee Attack. If the Attack hits, it is automatically upgraded to a True Hit. Until you make that Attack, you automatically fail all Defense Checks.

name: The Dark Heresy
description: The Minotaur culture have a long and storied history with Entities of the dark. Learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Fiend Spells.

name: Bond with Death
description: The Minotaur culture does not fear death and is trained to endure under the harshest of conditions. You act normally within Lifeline until reaching 2 Lifeline Points. Additionally, you cannot be Frightened and do not suffer the effects of Exhaustion while in Lifeline.

name: Hard Headed
description: The Minotaur culture settles many disputes by bashing heads together and clashing skulls. You can no longer unwillingly become Unconscious.

name: Legacy of Axes
description: The axe is the weapon of the Minotaur people and they honor that legacy. Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Slashing Weapons

name: Brutal Fighter
description: You gain Critical Hits with all Melee and Ranged Weapons

name: Bounty of the Land
description: The Stout-Folk are a culture that works the soil, from farmers to miners. Gain +1 Wilderness, +1 Smithing and +1 Cooking.

name: Action : Throwing Arm
description: You make a Throwing Attack with a +2 Bonus to Attack and double the Range you can normally throw that object or weapon. Additionally, a True Hit on this Attack is upgraded to a Critical Hit

name: Tavern Legends
description: The Stout-Folk culture is renowned for their prowess in the tavern. Gain +1 Resilience. When you complete a Favorable Full Rest after a day where you have consumed alcohol, gain a Luck Dice.

name: Truefooted
description: The Stout-Folk culture does not place much stock in footwear and have grown comfortable barefoot, growing protective calluses. Gain +1 Acrobatics, +1 Stealth and +1 Physical Mitigation.

name: Heavy Metal
description: The Stout-Folk are renowned for their complex metalwork, resulting in impressive hammers and plate armor. Gain an Infusion Slot when crafting Bludgeoning Weapons and Heavy Armor. Additionally, gain +1 Damage with Bludgeoning Weapons.

name: Action : Giantsbane
description: You make an Attack with a Weapon against a Creature one or more sizes larger than you and deal an extra 1d10 Primary Damage for each Size difference.

name: Legacy of Armor
description: The Stout-Folk are renowned for utilizing heavier armors for protection. Gain +1 Block, Resistance and Dodge while wearing Medium or Heavy Armor.

name: Raised in Water
description: The Tidewalker culture is at home in the water. Your Swim Speed becomes equal to your Movement Speed and you gain +1 Athletics.

name: Friend of the Sea
description: You You gain +1 Animals and +1 Persuasion. You can communicate basic concepts to Aquatic Beasts and the Level limit determined by your Taming Formula is increased by 2 for Aquatic Beasts.

name: Underwater Weapons
description: The Tidewalker Heritage involves weapons that work efficiently under water. Gain +1 Attack on Piercing Weapons

name: Hazards of the Sea
description: Your body is acclimated to the harsh conditions of the deep waters. Gain +3 Cold Mitigation and +3 Fire Mitigation

name: Songs of the Deep
description: Stories and messages are passed through song and you have learned to both sing and interpret them. Gain +1 Performance, +1 Search and +2 Range on all Ballads.

name: Underwater Diplomat
description: The Tidwalker culture invovles many different types of Creatures and sharing a common language is important for communication. Learn the Tidal Magical Language and gain +1 Persuasion

name: Water Shaper
description: You Gain +1 Spell Attack and you can Research Beginner and Journeyman Spells from the Aquamancy School of Magic. You can Research Journeyman Aquamancy Spells at Level 7, Expert at 9 and Master at 11. Additionally, while submerged in water, your Aquamancy Spells are automatically Charged.

name: Trained Assistants
description: The origin of the Gloxy involves being assistants, and that has carried into their culture. Gain +1 Scribing and +1 Arcanum

name: Protection Magic
description: The Gloxy culture heavily favors Abjuratation Magic which was used to protect their former Vethi masters. Learn 2 Beginner and Novice Abjuration Spells and gain +1 Spell Damage.

name: A Desire to Help
description: The Gloxy culture believes in helping those with less experience. When you make an Assisted Check with a Skill that has a Bonus Modifier equal to or higher than the Bonus Modifier of the Skill you are Assisting, add a 1d4 to their check instead of rolling an Assisted Check.

name: Always Free
description: The Gloxy cherish freedom and are particularly suspicious when they feel as if their liberty is threatened. Gain +1 Insight and +1 Resistance.

name: Holistic Medicine
description: The Gloxy culture values an all-around approach to healing, requiring good food, medicine and alchemical concoctions. Gain +1 Alchemy, +1 Medicine and +1 Cooking.

name: Skilled Linguists
description: The Gloxy culture prides itself on learning new Languages and accurately reproducing the dialects. Gain +1 Performance and learn 2 non-Magical Languages.

name: Manipulators of Magic
description: You cannot fail an Essence Burn and can additionally perform an Essence Burn on a Conduit that is not bound to you. Additionally, when you Bond with a Conduit, you get credit for a Bond that is one tier higher.

name: Enlighteners
description: The Vethi culture shares a special relationship with all living things and find their purpose in the wilds. Gain +1 Animals and +1 Wilderness.

name: Rune Masters
description: Many of those within the Vethi culture are taught at a young age to runecarve. Gain +1 Runecarving and learn 1 Magical Language.

name: Burden of the Ancestors
description: Many within the Vethi culture are taught focus and inward dialog so that they do not repeat the crimes of those who came before. You gain +1 Concentration and +1 Insight.

name: Reaction [Daily] : Antimagic
description: In response to a Spell being Channeled within a number of Units equal to your Level, lower the Spell Attack by 1d8. If the Spell does not require a Spell Attack, the Spell fails if the result of the d8 is 6 or higher.

name: Abstained Magic
description: There are several groups within the Vethi culture that villify the use of Magic and train to resit its effects. You have a -1 Penalty to Spell Attack but gain +4 Arcane and +4 Psychic Mitigation.

name: Embraced Magic
description: There are several groups within the Vethi culture that want to reclaim the old ways. Gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage but suffer a -2 Penalty to Arcane and Pyschic Mitigation.

name: Ultimate Focus
description: Those with great promise are taught the ancient ways of the Vethi and can split their thought into multiple strands. You are able to Focus on two things at once, though Concentration Checks you make have a 1d4 Penalty when using this ability.

name: Minor Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Beginner Spells from the Divine or Aeromancy schools of magic.

name: Innate Levitation
description: Gain a Hover Speed equal to your Movement Speed.

name: Skylord's Protection
description: Gain +2 Lightning, +1 Dark and +1 Physical Mitigation

name: The Language of the Wind
description: You gain the Aeron Language and gain +1 Spell Damage

name: Action [Daily] : Elemental Form
description: You take the form of an Air Sprite, gaining it's stat block for 1 minute or until you reach 0 Health. At Level 5, this ability improves, allowing you to take the form of an Air Elementaling instead. At Level 9, you can take the form of an Air Elemental

name: Reaction : Lightning Rod
description: In response to you or an ally within 4 units taking lightning damage, reduce that damage by an amount equal to your level. The next Aeromancy spell you channel before the end of your next turn is charged. If that spell deals lightning damage, the damage is increased by an amount equal to your level.

name: Lesser Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Novice Spells from the Divine or Aeromancy schools of magic.

name: Free Action : Smiting Thunder
description: After making a Melee or Ranged Attack, immediately make another attack with that same weapon against the same target, dealing only the Primary Damage which is all converted to lightning.

name: Swift
description: You gain +1 Movement Speed and +1 Dodge

name: Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Journeyman Spells from the Divine or Aeromancy schools of magic.

name: Storm Giant's Strength
description: Gain +2 Strength and +1 Damage with Melee Attacks

name: Action [Daily] : Mount of the Valkyr
description: You touch a Horse, transforming it into a Pegasus which is considered your pet. This enchantment lasts until the Pegasus dies, which it returns to the Plane of Valor. Only one horse can be transformed by this enchantment at a time.

name: Greater Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Expert Spells from the Divine or Aeromancy schools of magic. At level 10, learn 2 Master Spells from the Divine or Aeromancy schools of magic. Additionally, gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Action : Lighter than Air
description: You take a modified version of the Move Action where you have a flight speed equal to 8 units plus your Spell Damage Bonus Modifier. This movement does not provoke reactions.

name: Aeron Connection
description: You have a connection with the Plane of Aeron, or one of it's adjacent planes, manifesting in minor or major changes to your appearance.

name: Minor Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Beginner Spells from the Fiend or Pyromancy schools of magic.

name: Action : Break Flame
description: You target a creature that is Ignited of Frozen within 12 units and immediately end the condition.

name: Firecraft
description: Your skills at manipulating flames has given you a bonus to crafting. Gain +1 Cooking, Alchemy and Smithing

name: Infernal Speech
description: You gain the Infernal Language and gain +1 Spell Damage

name: Action [Daily] : Elemental Form
description: You take the form of a Fire Sprite, gaining it's stat block for 1 minute or until you reach 0 Health. At Level 5, this ability improves, allowing you to take the form of an Fire Elementaling instead. At Level 9, you can take the form of an Fire Elemental

name: Defense of the Dark Flames
description: Gain +3 Dark and +3 Fire Mitigation

name: Lesser Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Novice Spells from the Fiend or Pyromancy schools of magic.

name: Free Action : Devil's Whip
description: You summon a whip of fire and immediately make a light 1-handed slashing attack against a creature within 3 units, dealing fire damage. On a True Hit, the creature becomes ignited.

name: Devil's Sight
description: You gain +2 Search and Ultravision, but suffer a -4 penalty to your Divine Mitigation.

name: Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Journeyman Spells from the Fiend or Pyromancy schools of magic.

name: Burning Resolve
description: Gain +1 Resilience and Immunity to the Diseased and Poisoned Conditions

name: Action [Daily] : Hellsteed
description: You touch a Horse, transforming it into a Nightmare which is considered your pet. This enchantment lasts until the Nightmare dies, which it returns to the Infernal Plane. Only one horse can be transformed by this enchantment at a time.

name: Greater Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Expert Spells from the Fiend or Pyromancy schools of magic. At level 10, learn 2 Master Spells from the Fiend or Pyromancy schools of magic. Additionally, gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Reaction : Vengeful Flames
description: In response to a creature within 10 units dealing damage to you, curse them with fire, dealing damage equal to twice your level which cannot be defended against.

name: Infernal Connection
description: You have a connection with the Infernal Plane, or one of it's adjacent planes, manifesting in minor or major changes to your appearance.

name: Minor Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Beginner Spells from the Druidic or Geomancy schools of magic.

name: Tunneler
description: Gain a Burrow Speed equal to your Movement Speed.

name: Earthen Crust
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation and +1 Block

name: The Language of the Earth
description: You gain the Okkor Language and gain +1 Spell Damage

name: Action [Daily] : Elemental Form
description: You take the form of an Earth Sprite, gaining it's stat block for 1 minute or until you reach 0 Health. At Level 5, this ability improves, allowing you to take the form of an Earth Elementaling instead. At Level 9, you can take the form of an Earth Elemental

name: Might of the Land
description: Gain +1 Wilderness, +1 Strength and +1 Resilience

name: Lesser Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Novice Spells from the Druidic or Geomancy schools of magic.

name: Geocrystals
description: Your connection to the Plane of Okkor has manifested on crystal-like growths on your body that facilitate magic. Gain +10 Power and +10 Power Regeneration.

name: Action : Geowave
description: You make a Melee Attack against the ground, causing a wave of energy striking any creature within 2 units with a Force Attack. Any Huge or smaller creature who fails the check falls prone and takes Physical Damage equal to your level.

name: Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Journeyman Spells from the Druidic or Geomancy schools of magic.

name: Okkor's Binding
description: When crafting weapons or armor, you can add an additional infusion. Additionally, weapons you craft gain the Magical trait and armor you craft gains +1 Physical Mitigation.

name: Action [Daily] : Gift of Nature
description: You touch another creature, granting them 3 Physical and 3 Elemental Mitigation for an hour. This effect is doubled on beasts.

name: Greater Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Expert Spells from the Druidic or Geomancy schools of magic. At level 10, learn 2 Master Spells from the Druidic or Geomancy schools of magic. Additionally, gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Action : Solid as Stone
description: You take the Defend Action and gain Physical and Arcane Mitigation equal to your Level until the start of your next turn.

name: Okkor Connection
description: You have a connection with the Plane of Okkor, or one of it's adjacent planes, manifesting in minor or major changes to your appearance.

name: Minor Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Beginner Spells from the Fiend or Aquamancy schools of magic.

name: Waterborn
description: You gain a swim speed equal to your movement speed and the ability to breath under water.

name: Abyssal Speech
description: You gain the Abyssal Language and gain +1 Spell Damage

name: Defense of the Cold Depths
description: Gain +3 Dark and +3 Cold Mitigation

name: Action [Daily] : Elemental Form
description: You take the form of a Water Sprite, gaining it's stat block for 1 minute or until you reach 0 Health. At Level 5, this ability improves, allowing you to take the form of an Water Elementaling instead. At Level 9, you can take the form of an Water Elemental

name: Icecraft
description: You can spend 1 minute creating either a light melee weapon or a piece of ammunition out of an area of water greater in size than 1 cubic unit which is not consumed. This ammunition or weapon has it's primary damage converted to eiterh Dark or Cold Damage and melts at the end of your next Full Rest.

name: Lesser Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Novice Spells from the Fiend or Aquamancy schools of magic.

name: Action : Cold Flames
description: You target a creature that is ignited and turn the flame cold and blue, causing the condition to deal cold damage instead. A creature must spend 2 actions to put out a cold flame as opposed to one. This ability can also be used on an open flame that fits within a 1 unit cube.

name: Devil's Sight
description: You gain +2 Search and Ultravision, but suffer a -4 penalty to your Divine Mitigation.

name: Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Journeyman Spells from the Fiend or Aquamancy schools of magic.

name: Reaction [Daily] : Refreshing Ice
description: In response to taking enough Cold Damage to penetrate your Mitigation, you gain the Frozen Condition. At the start of each turn, you recover Health equal to your level. This condition ends when you reach full Health or the condition ends from taking Fire Damage.

name: Frozen Aura
description: When an enemy creature starts their turn within 2 units of you, their Movement Speed is halved for the first Move Action they take. You can activate and deactivate this ability at will.

name: Greater Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Expert Spells from the Fiend or Aquamancy schools of magic. At level 10, learn 2 Master Spells from the Fiend or Aquamancy schools of magic. Additionally, gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Action : Become Water
description: You teleport to a Location within a body of or a cloud of steam that you can see within 10 nits without provoking Reactions. The area must be large enough to completely surround your form.

name: Abyssal Connection
description: You have a connection with the Abyssal Plane, or one of it's adjacent planes, manifesting in minor or major changes to your appearance.

name: Minor Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Beginner Spells from the Fey school of magic.

name: Prankster
description: The Fey culture has given you an appreciation for tricks. Gain +1 Thievery and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Free Action : Names
description: You speak the true name of a humanoid you can see within 10 units. For the next minute, the target has a 1d4 penalty to the next Resistance Check they make against you.

name: Protection of the Glade
description: You Gain +1 Resistance, +1 Arcane Mitigation and learn the Sylvan Language

name: Feymind
description: Your mind is protected from the trickery of others. Gain +2 Psychic and Immunity to the Charmed Condition.

name: Siren's Song
description: Learn a Magical Ballad and gain +1 Performance. If you don't already have it, you gain the ability to play Ballads which require an Action to start and your Focus to maintain which can affect anyone within 4 Units who can hear.

name: Lesser Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Novice Spells from the Fey school of magic.

name: Action [Daily] : Sprite Form
description: You transform into either a Sprite or Pixie, taking on their statblock, but retaining your Knowledge and Social skills. This transformation lasts until you willfully end it or you reach 0 Health, at which point you transform back into your original form.

name: Reaction : Feyshift
description: As a Reaction to being the target of an Attack, you attempt to avoid it by shifting briefly into the Feywild, gaining a 2d4 bonus to your Defense Check. This ability only works on the Material Plane.

name: Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Journeyman Spells from the Fey school of magic.

name: Action : Fey Dust
description: You sprinkle fey dust on a creature, granting them flight for the next minute.

name: Free Action : Dreamweaver
description: The next Melee or Ranged Attack you make this turn deals Psychic Damage instead of it's normal Primary type. If the damage brings a creature to 0 Health and it is not immune to the sleeping condition, it gains the sleeping condition for 1 hour.

name: Greater Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Expert Spells from the Fey school of magic. At level 10, learn 2 Master Spells from the Fey school of magic. Additionally, gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Action [Daily] : Charm
description: Using your innate Fey magic, you attempt to charm a Creature that you can see within 10 units by making a Performance Check against their Resistance. On a success, the creature is charmed by you for an hour or until it breaks naturally. On a failure, the creature is not aware of your attempt.

name: Fey
description: You have the Fey creature type, as well as the humanoid type. Your fey lineage also has physical implications, changing your appearance in a minor or drastic way.

name: Curse of Gloombarrow
description: When you reach 0 Health, you do not enter Lifeline. Instead, you die and reanimate with full health in 1d4 days. When you complete a full rest, you lose any conditions affecting you, gain full health and you regenerate any lost body parts unless your body was completely destroyed.

name: Grotesque Form
description: Your body has become grotesque due to the curse, but more durable. You gain +8 health but suffer a -2 Penalty to your Persuasion

name: Ancient Knowledge
description: Learn 1 Magical Language and 1 Non-Magical Language. Additionally, gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Academics

name: Deadskin
description: You gain Immunity to the Wounded Condition and Gain +1 Physical and +2 Dark Mitigation

name: Action : Detatchable Parts
description: You detatch either a hand or eyeball from your body. When the hand is detatched in this way, it takes on the Undead Hand Statblock which you control. An eye detatched in this way grants you Sight in a 4 unit radius from the location of the eyeball when it is less than 100 Units away. A body part can be reattached by using this Action again.

name: Ghoulish Desires
description: You can spend 1 Minute consuming a Medium or smaller Beast or Humanoid corpse, gaining Temporary Health equal to twice it's level that lasts until the end of your next full rest

name: Reaction : Undead Fortitude
description: In response to being the target of an ability that requires you to make a Resilience or Resistance Check, gain a 1d6 Bonus to your roll. If the resulting ability deals Psychic Damage, that damage is halved before applying mitigations.

name: Free Action : Tainted Bile
description: You smear a Weapon with bile, tainting it for the next Attack you take before the end of your turn. When you deal Physical Damage with this Weapon, the creature must make a Resilience Check against the total damage dealt after Mitigation or they get a modified version of the Poisoned Condition which deals 2d4 Dark Damage and prevents a Creature from recovering Health while affected.

name: Action [Daily] : Banshee Scream
description: You unleash a wave of sonic energy in a 4 Unit Radius dealing 1d4 Dark Damage per Level. Humanoids and Beasts that are lower Level than you become Afraid until the end of your next turn.

name: Eyes of the Dead
description: You Gain +2 Search and the Undead variant of Ultravision.

name: Supernatural Strength
description: Gain +1 Strength, +1 Athletics and +1 Damage with Melee Attacks

name: Necromancy
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack and Learn 2 Beginner, Novice and Journeyman Necromancy Spells

name: Cursebreaker
description: All Critical and Brutal Critical Hits are downgraded to normal True Hits against you. Additionally, when you die, you can attempt to make a Resilience Check of 12 or higher to remove your curse, causing you to die without reanimating, freeing your spirit and allowing you to be resurrected with magic. This removes the Undead Module.

name: Reaction [Daily] : Still As Death
description: In response to taking Damage, you fall down in a heap, indistinguishable from real death. After 1 Minute, you recover half of your maximum Health.

name: Undead
description: Your creature type becomes Undead, granting you Immunity to the Diseased, Poisoned, Bleeding and Exhausted Condition. You can not benefit from Consumables such as Potions, Food and Snacks or be affected by magic that restores Health.

name: Knowledge of the Hive
description: Gain +1 to all Knowledge Skills

name: Action : Calming Pheromones
description: For 5 turns, you emit pheromones in a 3-unit radius. At the start of their turn, humanoids and beasts within the area must make a contested Resilience check against 1d12 + half your level. On a failure, they cannot act aggressively unless they or their allies are harmed or threatened. A successful check grants immunity until their next full rest. Additionally, Gain +1d4 to social checks against affected creatures.

name: Crafting Aura
description: Gain +1 to all Crafting Skills. You can also assist others with recipes, granting them a +1 bonus to all Craft Checks.

name: Party Link
description: When you spend a full rest within an enclosed space with one or more humanoids, you can share thoughts and ideas with them telepathically within 10 units until your next full rest.

name: Multifaceted Eyes
description: Your connection to the hive has resulted in a physical evolution of your eyes granting you Ultravision.

name: Feelers
description: You have developed extrasensory feelers that grant you Tremorsense and the ability to determine if a creature or object is diseased or poisoned by touching it.

name: Free Action : Orchestrate
description: You telepathically coordinate an action with an allied creature within 8 units that is under the effect of your Party Link trait. You coordinate one of the following actions: Use, Attack, Shove.

name: Improved Link
description: Your Party Link trait allows two-way communication and no longer has a maximum range as long as the target is on the same celestial body as you. This additionally grants you a 2d4 bonus to insight checks against humanoids you are linked with.

name: Reaction : Shared Knowledge
description: In response to a humanoid under the effect of your Party Link trait that you can see making a Defense or Knowledge Check, grant them a 1d4 bonus.

name: Hive Elite
description: You have absorbed skills from the hive to make you a more proficient protector. Gain +1 Attack and +1 Spell Attack

name: Chitinous Growths
description: Gain +1 Physical and +1 Elemental Mitigation while not wearing armor

name: Action [Daily] : Agitating Pheromones
description: You release pheromones within a radius equal to half your level that affects all Monsters, Beasts and Humanoids within the area who are not under the effect of your Party Link trait. Each creature must make a Resilience Check against 1d12 plus half your level or become either Maddened or Confused, which you must specifiy before using this ability.

name: Action [Daily] : Hive Recruiter
description: You attempt to bring a humanoid under the effect of your party link closer to the hivemind by making a 1d12 check plus half your level against their resilience modifier. If successful, they are charmed by you until the end of your next full rest. If you successfully charm this humanoid three days in a row, they are absorbed into the hive.

name: Reaction [Daily] : Consult the Hive
description: In response to making a Skill Check, you consult the hive and gain their combined skills to aid you, granting you a 2d4 bonus.

name: Hivemind
description: You are a member of a Klaktil Hive and have been absorbed into their unified mind. While the king or queen of the hive is alive and on the same celestial body as you, you are considered permanently charmed by the hive and are immune to charm effects from other sources. You no longer have the ability to focus but are considered to be alerted when you are conscious but are immune to the confused and maddened condition.

name: Magic Crafts
description: Gain +1 Runecarving, +1 Scribing and +1 Alchemy

name: Subject Expert
description: Become Good at one Knowledge Skill

name: Polyglot
description: Learn one non-Magical Language and one Magical Language

name: Problem Solver
description: Gain +1 Concentration and +1 Arcanum

name: Reaction : Hyperfocus
description: In response to making a Concentration Check from taking Damage while Focusing on a Spell, gain a 1d4 Bonus to that Check. If you successfully maintain Focus, gain a Bonus to any Defense Checks until the start of your next turn equal to the result of the d4.

name: Reaction : Interception
description: In response to a Creature making a Projectile or Ray Attack that travels within 10 Units of you, you Channel a Projectile or Ray Spell that takes 1 Action. Roll a 1d12 and add a +2 Bonus for each Level of the Spell you Channeled. If your Roll is greater than the initial Attack Roll, the Projectile or Ray is destroyed and does not reach its Target.

name: Exotic Magic
description: You choose one exotic school of magic which you can now research Beginner and Novice spells from. Journeyman spells can be researced at level 7 and Expert at level 9.

name: Duelist Stance
description: Gain the Dueling Fighting Stance

name: Flourish
description: Gain +1 Performance and +1 Damage to Weapon Attacks

name: Lean Fighter
description: Gain +1 Athletics and +3 Health

name: Reaction : Parry
description: After a Creature makes a Melee Attack roll on you or against a Creature that is Adjacent to you, roll a 1d4 subtract that amount from the Attack Check.

name: Action : Make Space
description: If there are two or more enemies adjacent to you, make a sweeping Attack, making a single roll against all adjacent targets. You can immediately move 2 units without provoking Reactions.

name: Action : Challenge
description: You use your Focus issue a challenge to to a Creature, causing your Attacks to deal an extra 1d8 Damage.  This effect persists until someone other than you does Damage to this Creature. This Focus cannot be broken by taking damage.

name: Master Duelist
description: Gain +1 to Melee Attacks and +1 Block.

name: Skulker
description: Gain +1 Stealth and +1 Thievery

name: Action : Deadly Poison
description: You make an Attack with a Weapon or piece of Ammunition that is coated in Poison and roll a 1d4. If the Attack hits, instead of your Target becoming Poisoned, they take instantaneous Poison Damage as if the Poison lasted a number of rounds equal to the result of the d4.

name: Free Action : From the Shadows
description: After making an Attack while Hidden, you roll a Stealth Check with a 1d4 Penalty and attempt to remain Hidden.

name: Quick and Silent
description: Gain +1 Steath and +1 Movement Speed

name: Stealth Specialist
description: Gain +2 Attack when Hidden or Invisbile and your True Hit threshold is increased by 1.

name: Poisoned Blade
description: Gain +1 Alchemy and +1 Damage to Piercing Weapons

name: Action: Assassinate
description: You make a quick and deadly attack with a Light 1 Handed Weapon. If you are Hidden deal an additional 2d8 Damage which is doubled in the event of a True Hit. If you are not Hidden, this Attack deals an extra 1d8 Damage and is also doubled in the event of a True Hit.

name: Close Combat Specialist
description: Gain +1 Concentration and Gain +1 Strength

name: Quick Cast
description: Removes 1 Action of Cast Penalty from Medium or Heavy Armor

name: Innate Spells
description: Learn Two Beginner Spells and Two Novice Spells from any one Traditional School of Magic

name: Reaction : Endure
description: If you are forced to make a Concentration Check after taking Damage to maintain your Focus, choose to succeed automatically.

name: Dual Training
description: Gain +1 to Melee Attacks and +1 Spell Attack

name: Battlemagic
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage and +1 Physical Mitigation

name: Free Action : Spell Combo
description: If you hit an enemy with a Melee Weapon, you Channel a Spell that takes only 1 Action. This Spell cannot be Charged.

name: Monster Bane
description: Gain a 1d4 Bonus to Defense Checks against Monsters and Beasts.

name: Monster Tracker
description: Gain +1 Search and +1 Initiative

name: Fearless Hunter
description: Gain Immunity to the Afraid Condition

name: Action : Devastate
description: If you have Moved at least 4 Units on a turn, you can make a Melee Attack dealing bonus Damage equal to the distance in Units you moved. If the Target is a Monster or Beast, this bonus is doubled.

name: Increased Potency
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage and Gain +1 Damage with Melee Attacks

name: Monster Tamer
description: You can Tame a Monster as a Pet within the Level of the Pet Taming Formula using your Persuasion Skill instead of your Animals Skill.

name: Action : Monster Harvest
description: You make an Attack with a Spell or Weapon. If this Attack brings a Creature to 8 or less Health, the Monster is executed. You gain Permanent Temporary Heath that recharges after each Full Rest equal to the Level of the Monster you killed. Other effects that grant Temporary Health no longer work on you.

name: Wildchild
description: Gain +1 Wilderness and +1 Stealth

name: Falconry
description: Gain +1 Animals. If you utilize a Pet with a Flight Speed to make an Assisted Check while Searching, gain a 1d4 Bonus to your Check.

name: Fletcher
description: Gain +1 Ammocraft and +1 Damage to Ranged Weapons

name: Of the Land
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed. Your Swim and Climb Speed become equal to your Movement Speed and you take Half Damage from falling.

name: Action : Hunters Instinct
description: You make a Ranged Attack against a Creature. If the Attack hits, you make a Contested Initiative Check against the Target. On a success, the Creature takes an extra 1d10 Damage. If the Creature is a Beast, the extra damage becomes 2d12.

name: Reaction : Quick Shot
description: In response to a Creature Attacks makes a Melee Attack against you, make an uncoordinated Attack at them with a 1d4 Penalty, lowering their Attack by the same amount.

name: Ranger of the Wilds
description: Gain +1 Attack with Slashing, Piercing, Crushing and Ranged Weapons and +1 Wilderness

name: Savage
description: Lose 2 Dodge and Block while gaining +2 Damage to all Melee Weapons and +1 to Melee Attacks

name: Ferocious Strikes
description: Gain +1 Damage to Melee Attacks and +1 Strength

name: Warrior
description: Gain +1 Resilience and +3 Health

name: Reaction : Berserker Endurance
description: In response to being the target of a Melee Attack, you make a Resilience Check instead of a Block or Dodge Check agains the Attack Check. On a success, you do not take any Damage. On a failure, you reduce the Damage by a result equal to your Resilience Check.

name: Unyielding
description: You do not suffer the negative effects of being in Lifeline until you reach 1 Lifeline point, at which point you fall Unconcious

name: Executer
description: You can Critically Hit with any Melee Weapon or Unarmed Attack.

name: Free Action : Fury Swipe
description: Directly after taking the Attack Action, you make an additional Attack with a 1d4 Penalty.

name: Just Lucky
description: Gain 1 Luck Dice

name: Comic Relief
description: Gain +1 Performance. When you roll a 1 on a Defense or Attack Check, the next Ally to make a Defense or Attack Check within 8 Units of you gains a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Reaction : Duck!
description: In response to a Creature making a Melee or Projectile Attack at you, you roll an Initiative Check against the Attack instead in an attempt to redirect the Attack to a Creature that is Adjacent to you. If successful, the Adjacent Creature must make the Defense Check intead of you.

name: Scripted Fate
description: When you use a Luck Dice, you can instead roll a 1d4. On a 2 or higher, replace the original roll with an 11. Otherwise, the roll becomes a 1.

name: Reaction : Words of Wisdom
description: When an Allied Humanoid within 4 Units of you rolls a Skill Check, you offer up words of wisdom in the form of a motto or advice. You then make the same Check with a 1d4 Bonus that replaces the Check made by the Ally.

name: Free Action : Catch Phrase
description: You Speak your catchphrase before making an Attack. If the Creature dies or falls Unconscious as a result of this Attack, you and everyone within 8 Units who can Hear you gains a Heroic Action.

name: Last Words
description: In response to being in Lifeline even if you are Unconscious, you gather the strength to offer your final words to anyone within 4 Units, forcing a Death Check. When making your Death Check, you add your Performance Modifier to a maximum of 6 to the Roll.

name: Menacing Presence
description: Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Strength

name: Action : Hamstring
description: You make an Attack with a Slashing Weapon at a Huge or smaller Creature that has legs in an attempt to Damage them. If the Attack hits, the Creature has a maximum Movement Speed of 2 Units until the end of their next turn.

name: Reaction : Sharp Parry
description: In response to being the Target of a Melee Attack, you make an Attack with a Heavy Slashing Weapon instead of a Defense Check. If the result of your Check is higher, you deal Damage to the Target equal to your Bonus Damage Modifier and avoid the Attack.

name: Executor
description: Gain +1 Attack with Slashing Weapons

name: Sharpened Blade
description: Gain +1 Slashing Damage

name: Sense Weakness
description: Gain 1d4 Attack to Creatures that have at least 3 Conditions on them. Additionally, if a Creature is Unconscious, the Damage on your Attack is doubled.

name: Action : Guillotine
description: You make an Attack against a Creature that is Prone, dealing an extra 2d10 Primary Damage on a hit. The Dice become 4d10 if you score a Critical Hit.

name: Leadership
description: Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Insight

name: Reaction : Guidance
description: In response to an Ally being the Target of an Attack Roll, grant them a 1d4 Bonus to their Defensive Checks until the start of their turn.

name: Free Action : Forced March
description: You command an Ally to Move up to 2 Units without provoking Reactions.

name: Lead from the Front
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation, +2 Psychic Mitigation and +2 Health

name: Born Commander
description: Become Good at Persuasion

name: Free Action : Lead by Example
description: When you land a killing blow on an Enemy, you can grant an Ally within 10 Units Temporary Health equal to your Persuasion Modifier. If the killing blow was a True Hit, you gain a Heroic Action.

name: Coordinator
description: If two or more Allies are within 1 Unit of a target, all Melee Attacks on that target have a +2 Attack Bonus

name: Prepared Mind
description: Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Psychic Mitigation

name: Free Action : Suppress
description: You make a Sonic Attack at a Creature within 3 Units by making a Contested Check using your Arcanum against their Concentration. On a success, your Target has a 1d4 Penalty to all Spell Attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Reaction : Mageslayer
description: In response to a Creature Channeling a Spell within 3 Units that you have an unobstructed path to, you Move within your Melee Range and make a Melee Attack against them, dealing Bonus Damage equal to your Arcanum Bonus Modifier. The Creature must then make a Concentration Check to maintain Focus, or the Spell fails.

name: Hunter of Magic
description: Gain +1 Search and +1 Arcanum

name: Magical Sense
description: When a Spell is Channeled within 10 Units of you, you become accutely aware of other magic within the Area. This awareness extends to Spells of equal or lower Level than the initially Channeled Spell that are affecting Creatures or Objects.

name: Distracting Blows
description: When you force a Creature to make a Concentration Check to maintain Focus, the Required Check is increased by an amount equal to your Arcanum Modifier.

name: Spell Breaker
description: When you interrupt a Spell that is being Channeled or Maintained with Focus, you immediately gain an Action. This can occur once until the start of your next turn.

name: Melodic Conduit
description: You can use a Musical Instrument as a Conduit, allowing you to play Magical Ballads and Channel Spells. You gain the ability to play Magical Ballads which require an Action to start and your Focus to maintain which affect anyone within 4 Units who can hear. Learn 1 Magical Ballad of your choice.

name: Composer
description: Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Scribing

name: Enhanced Ballads
description: The Range on your Ballads is increased by 2

name: New Composition
description: Learn a Magical Ballad and gain +1 Concentration

name: Action : Improvise
description: You use your Melodic Conduit to Channel a Beginner or Novice Spell that requires your Focus without spending any Power or requiring you to be able to speak.

name: Free Action : Powerchord
description: If you are currently Focusing on playing a Ballad, you play a powerful note on your instrument, causing the next Spell you complete Channeling on this turn to be Charged.

name: The Magic of Music
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage, +1 Spell Attack and learn a Magical Ballad

name: Glory Shield
description: When you kill an enemy with a Melee Weapon, you gain Temporary Health equal to the Level of the Enemy killed that lasts for 1 minute.

name: Flexible Armor
description: Gain +2 Dodge while wearing Medium Armor or Heavy Armor

name: Champion
description: Gain +1 Damage to Melee Attacks and +1 Athletics

name: Free Action : Brutalize
description: When you deal a killing blow to an Enemy, you can use your Free Action to brutally savage them. You make a Contested Performance Check against the Resilience of any Enemy within 4 Units. On a success, they become Afraid of you until the start of your next turn.

name: Shotcaller
description: Your Called Shots do not suffer an Attack Penalty

name: Gladiator
description: Gain +1 Block and +1 Damage to Piercing Weapons

name: Action [Daily]: Finisher
description: Make an Attack against a Creature which is an automatic True Hit if it lands. If the Target is Afraid, this Attack gains a 1d4 Bonus. If you use the Brutalize Free Action after making this Attack, this Action is refunded.

name: Elemental Ammocrafter
description: Gain Access to Elemental Ammocrafting. You can use Beginner and Novice Level Catalysts in your Elemental Ammocrafter Recipes.

name: Double Infused Ammunition
description: When you Infuse Ammunition with both an Elemental Infusion and the cooresponding Area Infusion (Shocking,Shockwave,Burning,Frosted) of the same Subschool, the Primary Damage is negated, but everyone within the Area takes the Elemental Damage as Splash Damage.

name: Action : Purify Elements
description: You fire a piece of Ammunition with the Elemental Infusion on it, converting all of the Primary Damage to the Damage Type of your Infusion.

name: Improved Elemental Ammocrafting
description: Gain +1 Elemental Mitigation and +1 Ammocraft

name: Action : Lineshot
description: You fire a piece of Ammunition Infused with one of the Area Infusions (Shocking,Shockwave,Burning,Frosted), converting them into a Line with a Radius of 1 Unit and Length equal to your Ammocraft Modifier at the time of Crafting. Additionally, the Area persists until the end of your next turn, causing any Creature who moves through the affected Area to have to make the Check against the effects again.

name: Critical Elemental Infusion
description: On True Hits, the Dice for the Secondary Damage on your Elemental Infusions are doubled, including usages of Double Infused Ammuntion.

name: Improved Elemental Ammocraft
description: Gain +1 Ammocraft. Additionally, you can use Journeyman Catalysts in your Elemental Ammocraft Recipes at Level 7 and Expert at Level 9.

name: Initiative Taker
description: Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Initiative

name: Action : Charge Ahead
description: All allies within 10 Units of you who are lower in the Initiatve Order gain +2 Units of Movement Speed on their next Turn. If they use the Move Action on their turn, they gain Bonus Damage on the next Weapon Attack they make equal to your Persuasion Modifier

name: Reaction : Advise
description: When a Contested Check is made against an Ally within 10 Units, add a 1d4 to their Check if you you can speak and they can hear you.

name: Sociable
description: Become Good at one Social Skill

name: Free Action : Lead the Charge
description: After using the Move Action, grant all Allies within 10 Units that can hear you extra Movement Speed equal to your Persuasion Modifier on their next Move Action before the start of your next turn. If an Ally makes an Attack Roll after utilizing this extra Speed and is closer to you than they were at the start of their turn, they gain a 1d4 Bonus to it.

name: Action : To the Death
description: You make a Persuasion Check and drop into Lifeline, gaining Lifeline Points equal to your Check to a maximum of 12. Allied Creature who can hear you within 8 Units are not affected by the penalties associated with Lifeline until they reach 1 Lifeline Point. This lasts until you are no longer in Lifeline or fall Unconscious. If an Enemy dies within 8 Units of an Ally, all allies within that Radius gain 1 Lifeline Point.

name: Steadfast Presence
description: When an Allied Creature is within 8 Units of you, they gain a 1d4 Bonus to Resistance and Resilience Checks.

name: Free Action : Shield Bash
description: After making a Successful Melee Attack with a 1 Handed Weapon, you slam the same Target with your Shield, adding 1d6 Damage to your Attack.

name: Quick Guard
description: You can use a Block Check against Ray Attacks instead of your Resistance.

name: Savage Shield Bash
description: Your Shield Bash Damage becomes equal to your Strength Bonus Modifier.

name: Reaction : Cover
description: In response to an Ally that is Adjacent to you being Targeted by an Attack that is eligible to be Blocked, you make a Block Check for that Ally.

name: Shield Guardian
description: Gain +1 Block while wielding a Shield

name: Reaction : Spellshield
description: In response to being Targeted with a Spell, you gain a 1d4 Bonus to your Block Check. If a Line, Projectile or Cone Spell was successfully blocked, all Creatures within a 4 Unit Cone who are behind you in relation to the Direction of the Spell only take Splash Damage if they fail their Checks.

name: Dazing Shield
description: When you hit a Creature with the Shield Bash ability, they must make a Concentration against Half the Damage after Mitigation or become Dazed. If the initial Attack that prompted the Shield bash was a True Hit, the Target becomes Stunned instead if they fail.

name: Acceleration Magic
description: Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Spell Damage

name: Reaction : Spell of Opportunity
description: In response to a Hostile Creature leaving your Area of Control, you Channel a 1 Action Touch Spell against the Target.

name: Free Action : Mobile Casting
description: After using the Channel Action to complete a Spell, you move 2 Units as part of that Action.

name: Improved Spells
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Amplified Force
description: Your Ray and Projectile Spells deal unavoidable Splash Damage to Creatures that are Adjacent to your initial Target

name: Empowered Conduit
description: Gain +6 Power and +6 Power Regeneration

name: Action : High Velocity Magic
description: You Channel a Ray or Projectile Spell that takes 1 Action and gain a 1d4 Bonus to the Spell Attack Check. Additionally, the Range of the Spell is doubled and is not affected by Cover.

name: Penchant for Dramatics
description: Gain +1 Performance. You can use your Performance Modifier in situations where a Persuasion Check would be called for to persuade, deceive or intimidate.

name: Reaction : Feign Death
description: In response to a Creature making an Attack against you, make a Performance Check to pretend that you have died. Any Creature with a Persistent Insight Check higher than your Performance Checks can tell that you are feigning, otherwise you are believed to be dead.

name: Reaction : Mocking Taunt
description: In response to a Creature starting their turn within 4 Units of you, make a Performance Check against their Insight. If it fails, the Creature has a 1d4 Penalty to Attack Checks against any Target other than you. This does not work on Beasts, Constructs or Creatures without the ability to make Insight Checks.

name: Reaction : Improvise
description: In response to failing a Defense Check, make another Defensive Check using a different Skill with a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Performing Arts
description: Gain +1 Acrobatics and +1 Performance

name: Traveling Troupe
description: Gain +1 Cooking, +1 Resilience and +1 Wilderness

name: Free Action : Encore!
description: After rolling a True Hit on a Creature with an Attack, make a different type of Attack on the same Creature such as a Spell after using a Melee Attack or an Attack with a Ranged Weapon after hitting with a Melee Weapon. If the Target dies as a result of this Attack, you gain a Heroic Action.

name: Criminal
description: Gain +1 Thievery and +1 Initiative

name: Stalk
description: Gain +1 Stealth. You Movement Speed while Hidden is no longer reduced.

name: Kleptomania
description: Gain +1 Thievery. You gain benefits from stealing Objects. When you steal an Object, you gain 1 Temporary Health after your next Full Rest for each 20 Gold of value on the Object up to a maximum of your Level. For each successive Full Rest, you gain 1 Less Temporary Health until you the value becomes 0 or you Steal another Object.

name: Quick Escape
description: Gain +1 Dodge and +1 Initiative

name: Free Action : Pocket Sand
description: You toss either debris from your pocket or dirt from the ground at a Creature within 2 Units by making a Contested Thievery Check against their Initiative. On a success, the Creature is Blinded until the end of your turn and cannot take Reactions unless they have another sense to locate you by such as Echolocation or Tremorsense.

name: Free Action : Quick Hide
description: When you use an Action to Move, you can also Hide as part of that Action if no Enemy Creatures have Line of Sight on you.

name: Action : Cunning Strike
description: You make a Weapon Attack against a Creature who has at least 1 of your Allies Adjacent to them dealing an extra 1d12 Damage. You Target must make a Concentration Check against Half the Damage after Migitation or you are considered Hidden against them until the Start of your next turn.

name: Talented Musician
description: Learn a Ballad and gain +1 Performance

name: Perfect Focus
description: Become Good at Concentration

name: Born to Perform
description: Become Good at Performance

name: Songsmith
description: Learn a Ballad and gain +2 Range on your Ballads

name: Reaction : Bridge
description: While Focusing on a Ballad, you can mix in another Ballad as a Reaction that only lasts until the start of your next turn.

name: Reaction : Parody
description: When an Attack misses you or an Ally within your Ballad Range, you can use your Reaction to sing or play a quick parody about that Creature, causing them to have a 1d4 Penalty on their next Attack or Defense Check.

name: Mantle of the Minstrel
description: Creatures that can hear your Ballads cannot be Confused or Maddened. Additionally, affected Creatures do not fall Unconscious until reaching 1 Lifeline Point.

name: Free Action : As One
description: You control your Mount with a Free Action instead of an Action, allowing it to use two actions.

name: Skilled Rider
description: Gain +1 Animals and +1 Athletics

name: Saddle Shot
description: While mounted, you are not penalized for using ranged weapons against targets closer than your minimum range.

name: Cavalier Stance
description: You gain the Cavalier Stance, which you automatically assume when you Mount a friendly Creature.

name: Mount Tamer
description: Gain +1 Animals. When you Mount a Pet for the first time after a Full Rest, it gains Temporary Health equal to your Level.

name: Reigns of Steel
description: Gain +1 Athletics. When you or your Mount take the Defense Action, the other also gets the benefit.

name: Reaction : Mounted Maneuver
description: In response to an Attack against you or the Creature you currently have Mounted that requires a contested Block or Dodge Check, make a Check with your Athletics Skill instead. If the Attack still hits, it is Mitigated by an amount equal to both you and your Mounts combined Mitigation to that Damage.

name: Precise Throwing
description: Your Throwing Attacks with Weapons gain a +2 Bonus to their Attack Check.

name: Boomerang
description: When you throw a Light 1-Handed Weapon or Throwing Ammunition, it returns to your hand if the Attack hits.

name: Throwing Arm
description: You use your Athletics Modifier as the Attack Check for throwing Weapons, instead of the Weapon Skill Modifier.

name: Improved Throw
description: You can throw Heavy 1-Handed Weapons and gain +2 Range on all Throwing Attacks. Addtionally, gain +1 Athletics.

name: Action : Skillshot
description: Make a Throwing Weapon Attack or Throw a Small Object with no Penalty while throwing outside your Minimum or Maximum Range up to twice your Maximum Range, ignoring Partial Cover. The True Hit threshold on this Attack is increased by 2.

name: Action : Ricochet
description: Make a Throwing Weapon Attack and target an additional Creature within 2 units of your original target.

name: Reaction : Throwback
description: In response to being the single Target of a Projectile Attack, gain a 1d4 Bonus to your Defense Check. If you successfully Block or Dodge the Projectile, you can redirect it to a Target within your Throwing Range using your initial Defense Check as the Attack Check. If this Attack hits, it is upgraded to a True Hit.

name: Magismith
description: Gain Access to Magismithing. You can use Beginner and Novice Level Catalysts in your Magismithing Recipes.

name: Magismith Catalyst Expert
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage. Additionally, Catalysts that you create count as 1 tier higher for the purpose of Magismith Recipes.

name: Jewelry Infusions
description: You can add an additional Infusion to Rings you Craft.

name: Variable Mitigations
description: When you add a Magismithing Infusion to Chest Armor, a Shield or a Weapon, add +2 Mitigation of your choice against Dark, Divine, Arcane or Psychic to the Object.

name: Forged in Magic
description: Any Object you Craft receives the Immutable and Conduit Slot Infusion without consuming an Infusion Slot when you add a Lead Ingot to the Recipes.

name: Craft : Transfer Enchantment
description: You spend 1 Day and a Pinch of Powdered Gold to transfer all of the magical effects from one piece of Equipment to another non-magical piece of Equipment that occupies the same Equipment Slot as the original.

name: Improved Magismithing
description: Gain +1 Smithing. Additionally, you can use Journeyman Catalysts in your Magismithing Recipes at Level 7, Expert at 9 and Master at 11.

name: Free Action : Kick
description: When you successfully hit a Target with a Slashing, Crushing or Piercing Weapon, you can follow it up with an Unarmed Strike.

name: Action : Windup
description: You prepare a vicious strike, winding up for a powerful blow. Until the end of your turn, you cannot Move but gain a +1d4 Bonus on your next Attack with a Unarmed or Melee Weapon. If that attack hits, it is upgraded to a Brutal Critical.

name: Tough as Nails
description: Gain +1 Resilience and +3 Health

name: Melee Specialist
description: Gain +1 Attack with Slashing, Piercing, Crushing and Unarmed Strikes

name: Scrapper
description: Your Unarmed Attack Modifier becomes equal to the highest of your Slashing, Piercing or Crushing Attack Modifiers

name: Impact Fighting
description: Gain +1 Damage to all Melee Attacks

name: Effective Blows
description: Your Unarmed Strikes deal extra damage equal to your Strength Bonus Modifier instead of your Unarmed Bonus Modifier. Additionally, your True Hits with Slashing, Crushing, Piercing and Unarmed Strikes are upgraded to Critical Hits.

name: Action : Telepathy
description: You can speak into another Creatures mind that is within 10 units of you using your choice of Language. Magical Languages extend this Distance to 20 Units.

name: People Pleaser
description: Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Insight

name: Helpful
description: Gain +1 Academics and +1 Medicine

name: Interference
description: Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Psychic Mitigation

name: Action : Mind Aura
description: You reach out in an area with a radius equal to your level. You can sense the minds of any Humanoid or Beast and have a vague idea of their intent such as if they are hostile, scared or friendly.

name: Reaction : Empathy
description: When an Ally within 10 Units of you that you have Line of Sight on takes Physical or Psychic Damage, you can shield their mind with yours and split the Damage in half before applying Mitigation, with you taking one half, and your ally the other.

name: Action : Mindreader
description: You attempt to read the mind of a Creature that speaks a Language you understand by making a Contested Insight Check against their Resistance. On a success, you can read the most immediate thoughts of the Creature. Additionally, you can elect to deal psychic damage to them equal to twice your Level. On a failure, the Creature is aware that you are attempting to read their mind and you take Psychic Damage equal to the value of their Resistance Check and you cannot use this ability again until you take a Breather.

name: Quick Learner
description: When you gain access to a new tier of spells through a Core Module, learn 1 Spell from that tier automatically. This is retroactive for schools you already know.

name: Attuned
description: Gain +1 Arcanum, +3 Power and +2 Power Regeneration

name: Wisened
description: Gain +1 Academics and +1 Wilderness

name: Natural Magic
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Reaction : Inspire
description: When you or an Ally make a Knowledge Check, you inspire them, adding a 1d6 Bonus to their Check. This ability can only be used a number of times per day equal to your Knowledge Attribute.

name: Artisan
description: Gain +1 to all Crafting Skills

name: Superior Focus
description: While you are Focusing on a Spell or Ballad, gain +1 to all Defensive Checks and Immunity to the Maddened and Afraid Conditions

name: Dark Dabblings
description: Learn 2 Beginner and 2 Novice Spells from the Witchcraft or Necromancy Schools of Magic

name: Twisted Sorcery
description: Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Arcane, Divine and Dark Mitigation

name: Empowered Conduit
description: Your Conduit gains +4 Power and +4 Power Regeneration

name: Tainted Magic
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage but lose -1 Resilience

name: Free Action : Dark Gift
description: After rolling a Spell Attack from Channeling a Necromancy or Witchraft Spell, Reroll the Attack. If the result is the same or worse, take Psychic Damage equal to twice your level.

name: Action : Dark Prayer
description: You utter a Dark Prayer and roll a 1d4. You gain a Bonus to Resistance, Spell Attack and Attack until the start of your next turn equal to the result of the d4.

name: Dark Research
description: You can research and scribe Beginner and Novice spells from the Witchcraft and Necromancy schools of magic. At level 7, this extends to Journeyman spells and Expert spells at level 10. Additionally, gain +1 Scribing.

name: Bane of Dragons
description: Gain +1 Cold Mitigation, +1 Fire Mitigation and +1 Resilience

name: Toughened
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation

name: Piercer
description: Gain +1 Attack with Piercing Weapons

name: Slayer
description: Gain +1 Damage to Melee Attacks and +1 Lightning Mitigation

name: Giant Slayer
description: You gain a +2 Bonus to Block and Dodge Checks against Huge or larger Creatures

name: Reaction : Immobile
description: In response to being Shoved or Displaced, you catch yourself by jamming a Piercing Weapon into the ground, a Mounted Creature or other surface, preventing any Movement. This Reaction can also be used while Falling if there is a parallel wall or terrain within your Melee Reach.

name: Free Action : Spear Plunge
description: Directly after using the Jump Action, you crash into the ground making an Attack with a 2 Handed Piercing Weapon against all Creatures within your Melee Range. The Damage for this Attack is equal to 1d4 for each Unit of your Jump. If this Attack is against a Creature that is 2 Sizes larger than you, you automatically Mount it if it takes Damage after Mitgations.

name: Vow
description: You make a Vow to an Order that is willing to accept you, agreeing to abide by their code and rules. While your Vow is satisifed, you can take refuge within any establishment dedicated to your order, in which you are fed and boarded. A Full Rest within any establishment associated with your order is Favorable and you gain extra Health and Power equal to your Level.

name: Armored Knight
description: Gain +1 Resilience and gain +1 Physical Mitigation while wearing Medium and Heavy Armor.

name: Beacon of the Order
description: Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Strength

name: Squire
description: You are appointed a Squire by your Order who follows your commands as long as it does not break your Vow. Should the Squire die, you can be assigned another within any establishment dedicated to your order at the cost of 50 Gold. Upon reaching Level 9, your Squire can be upgraded to a Knight for 500 Gold.

name: Know No Fear
description: While you are not Maddened or Confused, you and any Ally within 6 Units are Immune to the Afraid Condition, ending the Condition if an Afraid Ally moves within this Radius.

name: Boon of the Vanguard
description: While you and your Squire are within 4 Units of each other, your True Hit threshold is increased by 1 and you gain a 1d4 Bonus to Resilience Checks. If your Squire is a Knight, they get this Bonus as well.

name: Free Action : Honor Strike
description: Make an Attack with a Weapon with no Bonus Damage Modifier. If the Attack hits, that Target has a 1d4 Penalty to Attacks against anyone other than you on their next Action or Bonus Action.

name: Sect
description: You are part of a religious order that worships an Entity or Entities associated with life or death. Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Runecarving

name: Of the Faith
description: Learn 2 Beginner and 2 Novice Spells from the Divine or Necromancy School of Magic

name: Brothers and Sisters
description: While you are within 6 Units of another member of your Sect or another Character who has the Sect trait, you reroll any Attack and Defense Checks when you Roll a 1 on a d12.

name: Servant
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage, +1 Dark Mitigation and +1 Divine Mitigation.

name: Craft : Sacred Symbol
description: When you Craft either a Shield, Necklace or Chest Piece, you can add a Conduit Slot Infusion without taking up an Infusion Slot and add iconography associated with your Sect. This Item gains +2 Spell Damage when Equipped by you or a member of your Sect as a Conduit.

name: Reaction : Absolute Faith
description: In response to making a Resistance or Resilience Check, gain a 1d4 Bonus. If the Bonus was the cause of a success, gain Temporary Health equal to your Level until the end of your next Full Rest. If you have the Brothers and Sisters trait, you can use this on any eligble member of your Sect within 6 Units.

name: Final Service
