description: In response to reaching 3 Lifeline Points or lower, you can choose to forfeit any remaining Lifeline points and skip ahead to making your Death Check, with the result needed to live becoming a 4 or higher. If you survive, you gain Health equal to double your Level. On a failure, you die and become eligble for a Pact with an Entity associated wtih your Sect.

name: Enforcer
description: Lose 1 Block and Dodge while gaining +2 Physical Mitigation and +1 Elemental Mitigation.

name: Unforgiving Strikes
description: Gain +1 Damage to Melee Attacks

name: Engager
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed and +1 Athletics

name: Vigorous
description: Gain +2 Health and +1 Resilience

name: Free Action : Pummel
description: When you score a True Hit on a Creature, roll a Contested Athletics Check against their Resilience. On a failure, the Creature becomes Stunned.

name: Action : Shieldbreaker
description: Make an Attack with a Melee Weapon with a 1d4 Bonus Modifier. If your Attack hits, the affected Creature has a Penalty to their next Block Check before the start of their next turn equal to the result of the d4.

name: Frontliner
description: Gain +1 to all Mitigations

name: Roguish Charm
description: Gain +1 Performance and +1 Thievery

name: Action : Cheapshot
description: Make an Unarmed Attack with a 1d4 Bonus to the Attack and Damage. If the Attack hits, the Creature moves to the bottom of the Iniative order. If this ability is used to initiate Combat or on the first round, the Creature also loses their first Action.

name: Reaction : Dirty Fighting
description: In response to an Ally making an Attack on a Creature that is Adjacent to you, make an Attack on that same Creature with a Light Melee Weapon or Unarmed Attack with a 1d4 Bonus Modifier.

name: Lucky Scoundrel
description: Gain 1 Luck Dice

name: Bluffer
description: Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Insight

name: Hidden Weapon
description: You can conceal either an Ultra Light Ranged or 1 Handed Light Weapon which can only be discovered by a Search Check of 12 or higher. Your first Attack with this Weapon in Combat gains a +2 Attack Modifier and is an automatic True Hit if it hits.

name: Action : Knife Trick
description: You throw a Light 1 Handed Melee Weapon at a Target within 3 units and immediately move Adjacent to that Creature without provoking Reactions. If your Attack hits, make an additional Melee Attack with the same Weapon with a -2 Attack Modifier.

name: Athlete
description: Gain +1 Athletics and +3 Health

name: Bodybuilding
description: Gain +1 Strength. You can use your Strength Skill to avoid Grapples and Shove Attacks.

name: Overpowering Strikes
description: Gain +1 Damage to Melee Attacks

name: Athletic Prowess
description: Become Good at one Might Skill

name: Endurance Training
description: Gain +1 Resilience. You do not suffer any new effects of Exhaustion until the end of Combat.

name: Sprinter
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed. You can take the Move Action as a Free Action.

name: Mind and Body
description: Gain +1 Block, Dodge and Resistance

name: Distance Shooter
description: Gain [Heavy +8 / Light +4 / Ultra Light +2] Unit Maximum Range

name: Action : Snipe
description: While you are Hidden from a Target, make an Attack with a Ranged Weapon. If the Attack hits, make a Contested Stealth Check against an Initiative Check of the Target. On a success, the Ranged Weapon Dice are doubled. On a success of 10 or more, the Ranged Weapon Dice are tripled.

name: Action : Trick Shot
description: You use 2 Ammunition and shoot them at different Targets that are within 4 Units of each other. Both Projectiles avoid any Partial Cover.

name: Accurate Shot
description: Gain +1 Attack with Ranged Weapons

name: Veiled Shot
description: Gain +1 Stealth and +1 Damage to Ranged Weapons

name: Lying in Wait
description: Gain +2 Attack with and an extra 1d6 Damage with Ranged Weapons while Prone

name: Longshot
description: Gain +1 Damage to Ranged Weapons and Additional [Heavy +5 / Light +3 / Ultra Light +1] Range

name: Improved Familiar
description: Your Familiar takes the form of a Level 1 Beast, inheriting its Statblock with a Knowledge and Social skill of -1.

name: Shared Magic
description: Your Familiar can Channel Beginner and Novice Spells that you know which do not require Focus or Components using your Conduit.

name: Battle Familiar
description: Your Familiar gains 5 Health, +2 Attack and +3 Damage.

name: Action : Familar Bond
description: You fall Unconscious and place your mind within your Familiar. For the next 10 Minutes, you can control the Familiar and use its senses.

name: Elemental
description: Your Familiar gains an Elemental Type, causing Physical Damage to be converted to that element and granting them a +5 Mitigation to that Damage Type.

name: Shared Connection
description: You and your Familiar gain Temporary Health equal to your Level at the end of a Full Rest. However, if your Familiar dies, you immediately take True Damage equal to your Level.

name: Ethereal Movement
description: Your Familiar gains +2 Movement Speed. Additionally, it gains a Fly and Swim Speed of 6 unless it is higher already.

name: Slinger
description: Gain the Dual Wielding Stance which allows you to equip an Ultra Light Ranged weapon in your Offhand. Once per turn, you can make an Attack with your Offhand that does not consume an Action and does not apply your Damage Bonus Modifier.

name: Free Action : Double Reload
description: Reload up to 2 Equipped Ultra Light Ranged Weapons that have an Ammunition Capacity.

name: Reaction : Cover Dive
description: When Targeted by a Melee Attack or Projectile, dive 2 Units without provoking Reactions and fall Prone while making an Attack with an Ultra Light Ranged Weapon with a 1d4 Penalty to hit. Gain a +2 Bonus to your Defense Checks against the Attack as well as any Bonuses for Cover in your new position.

name: Desperado
description: Gain +2 Units of Maximum Range on Ultra Light Ranged Weapons. Additionally, apply your Damage Bonus Modifier to Attacks you make with your Offhand Ultra Light Ranged Weapon.

name: Action : Point Blank Overload
description: You make an Attack with an Ultra Light Ranged Weapon at a Creature that is Adjacent to you, dealing an extra 1d6 Damage. If hit, a Large or smaller Creature must make an Athletics or Acrobatics Check against the total Damage dealt after Mitigations, or be Shoved 1 Unit backwards and fall Prone.

name: Action : Cover Shot
description: Make an Attack with your Offhand Ultra Light Ranged Weapon with a 1d6 Penalty and Move a number of Units equal to the result of the d6. When you reach your new Location, you can make an Attack with your Primary Weapon if eligble.

name: Master Slinger
description: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Ranged Weapons

name: Spell Thief
description: You gain +2 Flexible Spell Slots which you fill with any Beginner or Novice Level Spells from any Traditional School of Magic. When an Ally Channels a Spell with you as the Target, you can replace one of these Spells with the new Spell. You can slot Journeyman Spells at Level 9 and Expert at 11.

name: Increased Capacity
description: Gain +1 Flexible Spell Slot and +1 Arcanum

name: Potent Spells
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage

name: Reaction : Spell Steal
description: In response to a Spell being Channeled within 8 Units, you make an Arcanum Check against the Spell Attack. On a success and if you are capable of Learning the Spell, you replace one of your Flexible Spell Slots with this one.

name: Craft : Stolen Research
description: You can use the Research Recipe to permanently Learn a Spell within your Flexible Spell Slots if it is a Traditional School of Magic.

name: Spell Heist
description: When a Creature Botches their Spell Attack on your Spell Steal ability, the Spell fails and they cannot use that Spell again for 1 Hour.

name: Action : Channel Flexible Spell
description: You Channel a Spell from one of your Flexible Spell Slots which is automatically Charged and has a +2 Bonus to its Spell Attack.

name: Free Action : Spell Surge
description: After Channeling a Spell that has a Channel Time of 1 Action and has an Attack Roll, amplify it with a surge of magic increasing your Check by 1d4. In the event you roll a 1, you roll on the Surge Table which alters your Spell.

name: Charging Surge
description: When you use your Spell Surge, the Spell becomes automatically Charged on a d4 roll of 4.

name: Violent Surge
description: When you use your Spell Surge, you double your Damage Bonus Modifier on the Spell on any roll besides a 1 on the d4.

name: Chaos Mage
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Prepared Mind
description: Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Arcane Mitigation

name: Spell Power
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage and +1 Arcanum

name: Reaction : Empowering Surge
description: After a Creature within 10 Units Channels a Spell with a Channel Type of 1 Action, you amplify it with a surge of magic increasing your Check by 1d4. In the event you roll a 1, you roll on the Surge Table which alters your Spell.

name: Focused Evoker
description: Gain +1 Concentration and learn 2 Beginner and 1 Novice Evocation Spell.

name: Spellbound Weapon
description: If your Conduit is a Melee Weapon, it's attack becomes equal to your Spell Attack and it's Damage becomes equal to your Spell Damage Bonus Modifier.

name: Magical Defenses
description: Gain +1 Elemental Mitigation and +1 Arcanum

name: Spell and Blade
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage and learn a Fighting Stance from the Stance Table

name: Reaction : Transference
description: In Response to taking Arcane, Psychic or Elemental Damage, roll a Spell Attack and reduce the Damage by that amount. Until the end of your next turn, your Weapon deals extra Primary Damage equal to the amount reduced.

name: Free Action : Elemental Weapon
description: You Channel a Beginner Evocation Spell at a weapon you have Equipped causing it to take on the Element of the Spell. For the next minute, the Sword deals Damage of that Element instead of its Primary Damage.

name: Action : Arcane Assault
description: You make an Attack with your Spellbound Weapon with a 1d4 Attack Bonus. If your Attack hits, all of the Damage is converted to Arcane and the next Spell you Channel before the end of your turn is automatically Charged.

name: Witchdoctor
description: Gain +1 Alchemy and +1 Medicine

name: Mystic
description: Learn 2 Druidic and 2 Divine Beginner Spells

name: Spirit Companion
description: You convert a Beast tamed by you to a Spirit Companion during a 12 Hour Ritual removing any need to Eat, Breath or Sleep. When this Spirit Companion reaches 0 Health, it vanishes into the Ethereal Realm and must be summoned again using this same Ritual.

name: Elementalist
description: Gain +1 Elemental Mitigation and Learn 2 Novice Druidic Spells

name: Careful Healing
description: When you can administer one Potion or Spell that restores Health to an Ally while taking a Breather, increasing the effectiveness by adding one Dice to the total amount Healed.

name: Action [Daily] : Trance
description: Once per day, you take a Breather where you place yourself into a Trance. While in this Trance you are considered Unconscious for the duration and regain Health and Power equal to your Level when it completes.

name: Action : Dream Totem
description: You place down a totem on the ground which grants all Allies within 8 Units +1 Resistance and Psychic Mitigation equal to your Level while they are within the Area. Additionally, while an Ally is within the protection of the Totem, they cannot be put to sleep by magic or suffer the effects of Spells that cause nightmares or dreams.

name: Monk's Discipline
description: Gain +1 Damage with Unarmed Strikes and +1 Concentration.

name: Free Action : Palm Strike
description: After hitting a Creature with a Melee Attack, make an Unarmed Strike against the same Creature that deals no Damage against a contested Concentration Check. On a failure, the Target becomes Dazed until the end of their next Turn. On a True Hit, the Creature becomes Stunned.

name: Action : Flying Kick
description: You make a leaping Unarmed Strike moving up to 3 Units towards a Creature using your Acrobatics Modifier as the Attack Check. If the Attack hits, it deals Physical Damage equal to the result of your Check.

name: Trained Form
description: Become Good at either Acrobatics, Athletics or Concentration

name: Unrestricted Movement
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation and +1 Elemental Mitigation while wearing Light or no Armor.

name: Trained Form
description: Gain +1 Unarmed Attack and +1 Attack with Crushing Weapons

name: Reaction [Daily] : Resilient Soul
description: In response to being the Target of an Attack, halve the Damage before applying mitigation. If the resulting Damage brings you to 0 Health, gain 1 Health instead. Additionally, you Gain Temorary Health equal to twice your Level that lasts for 1 minute.

name: Spellshot
description: When your Ranged Weapon is a Conduit, your Ray and Projectile spells that target a single Creature use your Ranged Attack modifier instead of your Spell Attack Modifier. Additionally, the Range of these spells is set to your Maximum Range for your Ranged Conduit.

name: Arcane Power
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage and +1 Arcanum

name: Pure Shot
description: Gain +1 Damage with Ranged Weapons and +1 Maximum Range on all Ranged Weapons

name: Action : Arcane Blast
description: You target a point within 10 Units that you can see and make a Ranged Attack with your Spellshot Focus. All Creatures within a 2 Unit Radius of that point must make a Resistance Check against your Attack Roll or take 1d6 + your combined Ranged Damage and Spell Damage Bonus Modifier. The combined Damage Bonus is doubled on a True Hit.

name: Action : Heat Seaker
description: You make a Ranged Attack that is not affected by Cover at a Target you have seen in the past minute. The Targets Dodge Modifier cannot be used to attempt to avoid this Attack.

name: Action : Arcane Delivery
description: You Cast a Utility Spell that has a Channeling Time of 1 Action, but the Range becomes equal to that of your Spellshot Conduit. This Spell can only Target an Allied Creature.

name: Free Action : Ammo Infusion
description: When you successfully Channel a Projectile or Ray Spell through your Ranged Conduit, the Physical Damage from all other Ranged Attacks on this turn becomes the same Damage Type as the initial Spell.

name: Barbarian Armor
description: You cannot wear Medium or Heavy Armor. Gain +1 Damage to Melee Attacks and +1 Physical Mitigation

name: Whole of Body
description: Gain +1 Strength and +3 Health

name: Mental Endurance
description: Gain +1 Resilience and +2 Psychic Mitigation

name: Path of the Barbarian
description: Become Good at Strength or Resilience

name: Reaction : Primal Fury
description: When you are the Target of a True Hit, downgrade it to a normal hit but gain the Maddened Condition until the end of your next turn. This Condition cannot be nullified by Spells or Traits that cause Immunity to the Maddened Condition.

name: Reaction : Retaliate
description: After taking Damage by a Creature within your Melee Range, you can make a Melee Attack as a Reaction.

name: Action : In the Thick
description: You gain a bonus equal to your Resilience Modifier to all Mitigations and a 1d4 Bonus to your Melee Attacks until the end of your next turn.

name: Juggernaut Stance
description: Gain the Juggernaut Fighting Stance

name: Walking Fortress
description: Gain +1 Elemental Mitigation and +3 Health

name: Power Rush
description: Gain +1 Initiative and +1 Strength

name: Power Strikes
description: Gain +1 Damage with Melee Attacks

name: Action : Multislash
description: On your next Attack action this Turn, you can make 3 Attacks with a Heavy 2-Handed Weapon.

name: Action : Leaping Slash
description: You leap 3 Units and make an Attack against the closest enemy without provoking Reactions.

name: Free Action : Brutal Strike
description: While in the Juggernaut Fighting Stance, make a Shove Attack that can only be used to Displace. If the Shove Attack is successful, deal Physical Damage equal your Strength Modifier.

name: Free Action : Arcanist Charge
description: You can charge Spells at the expense of your mind. Whenever you use this ability, you take Psychic Damage equal to 1d4 per Power cost of the Spell.

name: Channeler
description: Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Concentration

name: Reaction : Empower Ally
description: When another Creature within 10 Units that you can see Channels a Spell, you can Charge it by spending 2 Focus Points.

name: Wizard
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Reaction : Prepared Spell
description: At the start of Combat, you can Channel a Spell that takes one Action before Initiative Order starts.

name: Arcane Dueler
description: Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Arcane Mitigation

name: Action : Mind Challenge
description: You utilize your Focus to make a Contested Arcanum Check against a Creature with the loser of the Check becoming Dazed. While you Focus on this ability, the Target has a 1d4 Penalty to Resistance and Concentration Checks. This does not work on Creatures who are not capable of making an Arcanum Check.

name: Guardian of Knowledge
description: Gain +1 Academics and +1 Insight

name: Reaction : Interpose
description: In response to an Enemy Creature Moving within 1 Unit of an Ally, you can move up to 4 Units towards that ally. If you end up within 1 Unit of both the ally and enemy, you can make an Attack Action against that target.

name: Reaction : Know Thine Enemy
description: When a Creature Attacks you with a Melee Attack, you can use your Academics Skill in place of a Dodge Check

name: Well Learned
description: Become Good at one Knowledge Skill

name: The Art of Defense
description: Gain +1 Dodge and +1 Block

name: Sentinel Stance
description: Gain the Sentinel Stance and +1 Academics.

name: Free Action : Feint
description: You make a quick Attack with a Light 2-Handed Weapon meant to distract, only dealing Primary Damage equal to the Bonus Damage Modifier and causing your Target to have a 1d4 Penalty to their next Defense Check before the start of your next turn. If the next Attack is a True Hit, the Damage is increased by 1d10.

name: Appraiser
description: You can appraise and study Objects by making an Academics Check during a Full Rest. On a 13 or higher, you can reasonably deduce the approximate age of the Object and how much it is worth. If you possess an Object either in your Inventory or Storage that is at least 100 years old, you gain a 1d4 Bonus to any Academics Checks when recalling information about the group that created it, if the creators or original owners are known.

name: Linguist
description: Gain +1 Academics and Learn a non-Magical Language

name: Archaeologist
description: Gain +1 Search and +1 Wilderness

name: Free Action : Exploit Weakness
description: If you deal Damage to a Creature as part of an Action, you can Learn its Mitigation to Damage Type(s) you did. If that Mitigation is less than your Academics Modifier, the next time your Target takes Damage of that Type before the start of your next turn they take an additional 1d8 Damage. If you possess an Object belonging to the Creatures culture, religion or nation that is at least 100 Years old, the Damage becomes 1d8 + your Academics Modifier.

name: Student of War
description: Gain +1 Damage to Weapon Attacks and +1 Persuasion

name: Student of Magic
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack and Learn a Magical Language

name: Antiquarian
description: Gain +1 Academics. Additionally, your Appraiser Trait grants a 1d4 Bonus to all Knowledge Checks instead of just Academics.

name: Investigator
description: Gain +1 Search and +1 Insight

name: Investigative Research
description: At the end of a Full Rest, you choose one Knowledge Skill. Until the end of your next Full Rest, you become Good at that Skill.

name: Quick Evaluations
description: Whenever an Initiative Check or Modifier is used, you can use your Insight Skill instead

name: Specialist
description: You choose a Creature Type besides a Beast or Construct. When you are on the receiving end of a True Hit from a Creature of this Type, it is downgraded 1 Tier. Additionally you gain a +2 Bonus when making Search and Insight Checks against this Creature Type. You can change this Creature Type when you Level or spend at least 1 Week of down time in a Settlement.

name: Good Cop
description: Gain +1 Persuasion and +1 Performance

name: Bad Cop
description: When you have dealt Damage to a Creature within the last minute, you gain a 1d4 Bonus to Insight and Persuasion Checks against them.

name: Free Action : Deduction
description: You attempt to read a Creatures body language and predict their most likely move by rolling a Contested Insight Check against their Performance. On a success, you gain a 1d4 Bonus to any Defensive Check you make against that Creature until the start of your next turn. This ability does not work on Beasts or Constructs.

name: Acrobat
description: Gain +1 Acrobatics and +1 Initiative.

name: Safe Fall
description: You take half Damage from falling that is applied after the Acrobatics Check to Mitigate the Damage. Additionally, you take no Damage when falling 6 Units or less.

name: Aerialist
description: Your Acrobatics Modifier replaces your Athletics for determining the distance you can Jump and checks that involve Climbing.

name: Reaction : Rolling Dodge
description: Gain +1 Dodge until the start of your next turn. Each time you Dodge an Attack successfully, gain another +1 Dodge until the start of your next turn

name: Action : Parkour Strike
description: Make an Attack with a +2 Modifier. If your Attack hits, you can bounce off your Target 1 unit plus a distance equal to your Melee Range and avoid provoking Reactions.

name: Quick Dodge
description: You can use your Dodge Modifier to Defend against Ray Attacks

name: Master Acrobat
description: Gain +1 Dodge, +1 Movement Speed and +1 Acrobatics

name: Inquisitive
description: Gain +1 Search and +1 Insight

name: Defense Against Darkness
description: You Learn 2 Beginner and 2 Novice Abjuration Spell

name: Seeker of Zealots
description: Gain +2 Dark Mitigation and +2 Divine Mitigation

name: Action : Condemn
description: You declare an Attack against a Creature, and then make that Attack with a +2 Bonus as part of the same Action. If you deal Damage to the Creature, you gain a 1d4 Bonus on your next Attack or Defense Check before the start of your next turn. If you miss, the Creature has a 1d4 Bonus to the next Attack or Defense Check it makes against you.

name: Insightful
description: You become Good at Insight

name: Holy Sight
description: You become Immune to the Blinded Condition and gain +1 Resistance

name: Free Action : Trial By Fire
description: If a Creature has dealt Dark Damage, is a Dark Creature or has Channeled a Necromancy, Fiend or Witchcraft Spell within the past minute, you can force a Contested Insight Check against their Persuasion. On a success, the Target takes Fire Damage equal to the total value of your Insight Check. This ability can be used without the prerequisites when you True Hit any Creature with an Action.

name: Action : Diverting Strike
description: You make an Attack with a Heavy Melee Weapon with a 1d4 Attack Bonus. If you miss, make a seperate Attack with a Light 1-Handed Weapon.

name: Weapon Expert
description: Gain +1 Smithing and +1 Damage to Attacks with Slashing, Piercing and Crushing Weapons

name: Armsman Stance
description: Gain the Armsman Stance

name: Recurring Blows
description: When you miss a Creature with a Melee Attack, the next Attack you make before the start of your next turn gains a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Reaction : Change Stance
description: You can use your Reaction at any point to change your Stance instead of an Action. As part of the Reaction, you can make an Attack with a Melee Weapon with a 1d4 Attack Penalty.

name: Free Action : Follow-up
description: After making an Attack with a 1 Handed Melee Weapon, you quickly fire an Ultra-Light Ranged Weapon and Reload it if it has an Ammunition Capacity.

name: Weapon Master
description: Your Ranged Attack, Slashing Attack, Piercing Attack and Bludgeoning Attack Modifier all become equal to your highest value Ranged or Melee Attack Modifier

name: Bulwark
description: While you are wielding a Heavy Shield, you also gain partial cover from Ray Attacks. Additionally, if you take the Defense Action, the bonus you receive from partial cover is doubled until the start of your next turn while you are wielding a Heavy Shield.

name: Shield Expert
description: Remove Dodge, Stealth and Movement Speed Penalties while using Shields

name: Hearty
description: Gain +5 Health

name: Shield Master
description: Gain +1 Block while wielding a Shield

name: Action : Hold the Line
description: Your Movement Speed becomes 0. You can maintain this indefinitely until you are Knocked Prone, or Stunned.  It costs 1 Action per turn to round the line, otherwise the effect ends.  While this ability is active, hostile Creatures cannot pass through an area in a 1 Unit radius around you.

name: Action : Shield Charge
description: You Move up to your Movement Speed, but at least 4 Units towards a Creature and make a Shove Attack. If successful, the Creature takes 1d6 Fall Damage and lands prone 1 Unit behind you.

name: Reaction : Critical Block
description: When you roll a 12 on a Block Check, the Attack misses, regardless of the enemy roll. Additionally, if the Creature that Attacked you is within your Melee Range, you can make a counter Attack with a 1-Handed Weapon that is upgraded to a True Hit if it hits.

name: Clearmind
description: You are proficient in relaxing your mind and recharging and can maintain a Full Rest within half the usual time.  Additionally, when you complete a Full Rest, you cannot gain less than twice your level in Health even if you are Wounded.

name: Focused
description: Gain +1 Concentration and +1 Resilience

name: Mental Protection
description: Gain +4 Psychic Mitigation

name: Action [Daily] : Center
description: You spend an Action to remove any Poison, Ignited, Diseased, Blinded, Dazed, Stunned or Deafened Conditions affecting you.

name: Free Action : Manifest Success
description: After rolling an Attack as part of an Action where the number on the die is less than a 6, add an additional 1d4 to your total.

name: Never Tired
description: You are Immune to becoming Exhausted and effects that make you Sleep.

name: Reaction : Mind Over Matter
description: When you take Damage as part of an Attack, convert all the damage to Psychic and halve it before applying the Mitigation.

name: Action [Daily] : Shadowspawn
description: You detach your shadow in an unoccupied area adjacent to you. It becomes a dark creature with health equal to double your level while sharing the same mitigations and movement speed as you. You can use a subsequent action to recall or deploy your shadow unless it reaches 0 health. The shadow acts on your Initiative and has one Action which it can only use to either Move or Attack with a Melee Weapon you have equipped. The shadow is immune to all conditions and has a size equal to your own.

name: Reaction : Swap
description: In response to either you or your Shadow being the target of an Attack, swap places causing the attack to be redirected. If your new position places you adjacent to a creature, you can make a Melee Attack against it.

name: Free Action : Shadow Strike
description: Your Shadow teleports up to 2 Units and uses the Attack action.

name: Shadow Aura
description: Both yours and your Shadow's Melee Attacks deal 2d4 bonus psychic damage on a True Hit. This bonus is increased to 2d8 at level 7 and 2d12 at level 11.

name: Inner Darkness
description: You gain +1 Stealth and +3 Dark Mitigation. Additionally, your Shadow becomes Immune to Dark Damage.

name: Dissipating Veil
description: After one round of not taking an action, your Shadow becomes Invisible until it makes an Attack.

name: Synchronous Shadow
description: Your Shadow gains another Action which can only be used to take the Use or Move action. Additionally, when it takes the Attack Action, it can use one of your Unique Actions as if you were using it.

name: Devout
description: You dedicate your channeling to a diety or entity that empowers your magic. You can only Cast Spells from the Abjuration and Divine Schools of Magic, however your Damage Bonus Modifiers are doubled on those Spells.

name: Crusader
description: Gain +1 Damage with Slashing and Crushing Weapons

name: Radiant Shield
description: Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Dark Mitigation

name: Dedication of Faith
description: Your Melee Weapons deal 1d4 Divine Damage which increases to 1d8 at level 7 and 2d8 at level 11. Roll an additional Dice against Undead and Dark Creatures.

name: Reaction : Healing Words
description: You Channel a Touch Healing Spell that requires 1 Action to Heal a Creature within 6 Units if they are able to hear you.

name: Free Action : Turn the Unfaithful
description: When you deal Divine Damage to a Dark or Undead Creature, you force them to make a Resilience Check against half the total Damage taken after Mitigations, or they become Afraid of you.

name: Improved Healing and Shielding
description: Your Healing and Shielding Spells are improved by 1 Dice.

name: Action : Calm Beast
description: You target a Hostile Beast and attempt to calm it by making an Animal Check against a Required Check of 3 + the Level of the Beast. If successful, the Creature is considered Charmed by you for 1 Hour where it will attempt to follow your commands to the best of its ability. Only one Beast can be Charmed in this way at a time.

name: Safe Animal Handling
description: Gain +1 Animals and +1 Stealth

name: Primal Knowledge
description: Gain +1 Wilderness and +1 Initiative

name: Tamer
description: Your Maximum Pet Level for Beasts becomes equal to your Level - 2 with a minimum of 2.

name: Unburdened Pet
description: Your Pets are not subjected to the Pet Action Limits and can utilize their full Statblock.

name: Durable Pet
description: Your Pets gain maximum Health equal to your Level and +2 Physical Mitigation.

name: Extra Pet
description: The maximum amount of Pets you can have is increased by 1. Additionally, you can keep one Level 0 Pet that does not count against your Pet limit.

name: Good Physique
description: Gain +1 Acrobatics and +1 Athletics

name: Grapplemaster
description: A Creature that is Grappled by you has a 1d4 Penalty to their Attack Rolls.

name: Leverage
description: You can Shove and Grapple Creatures that are one Size larger than you.

name: Improvised Attacks
description: Gain +1 Attack with Crushing Weapons and Unarmed Attacks

name: Free Action : Powershove
description: When you make a successful Shove Action, you both displace and knock the creature Prone instead of choosing between the two.

name: Reaction : Reversal
description: When a Creature attempts to Shove or Grapple you, gain a 1d4 Bonus to your roll. If you win the Check, you can choose to Shove or Grapple the Creature.

name: Action : Slam
description: When you have a target Grappled or are adjacent to a target that is Prone, you make an Unarmed Attack on them that is upgraded to a Brutal Critical if it hits.

name: Always Ready
description: Gain +1 Initiative and +1 Athletics

name: Free Action : Double Toss
description: When you throw a Weapon with an Attack, you can throw an additional Weapon as part of that Action.

name: Action : Quick Fire
description: If you are behind Partial or Full Cover, you can move 2 Units and use the Attack Action or Channel Action and return to your original position.

name: Action : Disengage
description: You Move up to your full Movement Speed but do not provoke Reactions.

name: Nimble Engager
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed and +1 Acrobatics

name: Avoidance
description: Gain +1 Dodge

name: Reaction : Covered Retreat
description: When a hostile Creature moves within 2 Units of you, you can use your Reaction to Move up to 4 Units and make an Attack with a Ranged or a Throwing Weapon

name: Spectral Weapon
description: You designate a Light 1 or 2 Handed Melee Weapon as your Spectral Weapon with a 1 Hour Ritual. This weapon can be summoned and dismissed as a Free Action. If you throw this weapon, it appears in your hand after hitting or missing your target.

name: Spectral Shield
description: Gain +4 Psychic Mitgation

name: Spectral Twin
description: You can designate a second Weapon as a Spectral Weapon which behaves in the same manner. With a Free Action, you can summon one or both Spectral Weapon.

name: Ethereal Weapons
description: Your Spectral Weapons deal an extra 1d4 Psychic Damage. This dice increases to 1d8 at level 7, and 2d6 at level 10

name: Reaction : Spectral Parry
description: When you are Attacked by a Melee Weapon, you can summon a brief duplicate of your Spectral Weapon to attempt to Parry the Attack. Roll a 1d6 and add that to your Block Modifier.

name: Action : Psychic Onslaught
description: Until the end of your next turn, the Primary Damage of your Spectral Weapons are convereted to Psychic Damage.

name: Action : Phantom Rush
description: Your Spectral Weapon appears Adjacent to a Target within 6 Units. If your Attack hits, you dash to your weapon if nothing is obstructing your path. Otherwise, you remain in your current position.

name: Action : Kinetic Shot
description: You fire energy from your Conduit by making a Projectile Spell Attack at a Target within 6 Units, dealing 1d8 Physical Damage plus your Spell Damage Bonus Modifier. This Action does not have usage limits.

name: Potent Spells
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage

name: Kinetic Force
description: The True Hit threshold on your Kinetic Shot is reduced by 1. Additionally, when you True Hit with your Kinetic Shot Action, you can displace a Large or smaller creature 1 Unit.

name: Precision Blasts
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Free Action : Charged Shots
description: You empower your next Kinetic Shot this turn to become a Ray Attack that is a 1 Unit wide line, dealing Arcane Damage.

name: Free Action : Repeating Blast
description: After using your Kinetic Shot Action or Channeling a Spell against a target that has a channel time of 1 Action, use the Kinetic Shot Action against that same target.

name: Improved Kinetic Shot
description: The Damage on your Kinetic Shot is upgraded to 2d6 and the Range is increased to 10 Units. Additionally, your Kinetic Shot and Charged Kinetic Shot variant can Critically Hit

name: Innate Cosmic Magic
description: Learn 2 Beginner and 2 Novice Spells from the Cosmic School of magic

name: Free Action : Cosmic Charge
description: You spend 2 Power to Charge a Cosmic Spell that is being Channeled. If under Direct Starlight, this charge does not consume power.

name: Free Action : Cosmic Wrath
description: You spend one Power and make an infused Melee or Ranged Attack. If in Direct Sunlight, the Physical Damage of the Weapon is converted to Fire. Otherwise, the Damage becomes Arcane.

name: Expansive Mind
description: Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Arcane Mitigation

name: Armor of the Cosmic Knight
description: Gain +1 Block while wielding a Shield and +1 Physical Mitigation when wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

name: Weapons of the Cosmic Knight
description: Gain +1 Attack with Ranged, Slashing, Piercing and Crushing Weapons

name: Action : Flight of Ahkaris
description: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a Magical Flight Speed of 4 while in Direct Sunlight or Starlight. Each time you use Cosmic Wrath or Cosmic Charge Free Actions, this effect is extended until the end of your next Turn.

name: Potent Knowledge
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage and +1 Arcanum

name: Free Action : Spellsnipe
description: Directly after Channeling a Spell, you spend 1 Power to double the Range of it.

name: Free Action : Spellsculpt
description: Directly after Channeling a Spell, you spend 1 Power to change the Damage Type to Arcane or any Elemental Damage Type.

name: Tamed Magic
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Free Action : Careful Spell
description: Directly after Channeling a Line, Area or Cone Spell, you spend 2 Power, causing the Spell to ignores allies until the start of your next turn.

name: Free Action : Expanded Spell
description: Directly after Channeling a Line, Area or Cone Spell, you spend 2 Power to increase the Radius, Width or Size of the Spell by 2 Units.

name: Master of Control
description: Any time you use a Free Action from the Control Mage Module to cast a Spell, that Spell automatically becomes charged.

name: Dualwielder
description: Gain the Dual Wielding Stance which allows you to Equip a Light 1-Handed Melee Weapon weapon in your Offhand. Once per turn, you can make an Attack with your Offhand that does not consume an Action and does not apply your Damage Bonus Modifier.

name: Action : Disengaging Strike
description: You make an Attack with only your Offhand, using your Primary Weapon to fend off Attacks, granting you a +2 Dodge and Block until the end of your turn and allowing you to Immedietly move 3 Units.

name: Action : Synchronized Strike
description: Make an Attack with your Primary Hand. If the Attack hits, your next Offhand Attack until the end of your current turn has a +2 Attack Modifier and ignores Physical Mitigation.

name: Ambidextrous
description: You add your Weapon Damage Bonus Modifier to your Offhand Attacks.

name: Reaction : Cross Block
description: In response to being the Target of a Melee Attack, roll two Block Checks and take the higher of the two values. If the Attack is Botched, the Creature becomes Stunned.

name: Reaction : Dual Attack of Opportuntity
description: When a Creature leaves Area of Control, you can make an Attack of Opportunity with both your main and offhand Weapon.

name: Skilled Defense
description: Gain +1 Block, Dodge and Resist

name: Stick Fighter
description: Gain +1 Damage with Crushing Weapons and +1 Athletics

name: Action : Vault
description: If you have used the Move Action on your turn, you can make vaulting Attack against a Creature within 3 Units that has a +2 Attack Bonus while you have a 2-Handed Weapon equipped.

name: Reaction : Deflect Blow
description: When a Melee Attack is made against you, you can make a Weapon Attack instead of a Block or Dodge Check. If successful, you can redirect the Attack to another Creature that is within reach of the Attacker. This Attack has a -2 Modifier to hit the new target.

name: Staff Master
description: Gain +1 Attack with Crushing Weapons

name: Leveraged Defense
description: Gain +1 Block and +1 Dodge

name: Longstriker
description: Gain +1 Unit Range on 2 Handed Weapons

name: Action : Guard
description: You take an improved version of the Defense Action, gaining an additional +1 Bonus to your Defense Checks and allowing you to make a Melee Attack against any Creature that enters or leaves your Melee Attack Range without consuming a Reaction.

name: Booksmarts
description: Gain +1 Scribing. Additionally, gain +2 to Knowledge Checks when recalling historical events about Architecture, cultures and Famous Figures

name: Versed in Magic
description: Gain +2 Arcane Mitigation and +2 Psychic Mitigation

name: Lorekeeper
description: Gain +1 Academics, +1 Wilderness and +1 Arcanum

name: Student of Magic
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Master of Language
description: You learn one Magical and one non-Magical Language.

name: Master of Artifacts
description: You can attempt to Identify magical effets on an Object with an Arcanum or Academics Check of 12 and by spending 1 Hour studying it. With a 15 or higher, you recall information about any curses that may be associated with the Object.

name: Reaction : Student of Magic
description: When forced to make a Resistance Check against a Spell or Ability, you make an Arcanum Check instead.

name: Reliable Disguises
description: You can create 3 Personas the same Size as you that each require a Disguise Kit which does not get consumed upon use. Each Persona can consist of mannerisms and accurate accents that you are able to replicate. While you are disguised with one of the Personas, it is not possible for a Creature to identify your other identities through non-magical means.

name: Action : Sabotage
description: You make a Thievery or Engineering Check and touch an Object such as a mechanism, door, lever or other object that can be used, activated or triggered.

name: Free Action : Stride
description: You quickly dash up to 4 Units, allowing you to pass through a Creature that is Large or smaller without making a Check or provoking Reactions.

name: Blend In
description: Gain +1 Performance, +1 Thievery and +1 Stealth

name: Action : Quick Change
description: In repsonse to breaking Line of Sight with a Creature or multiple Creatures, you quickly change Personas. If a Creature gains Line of Sight on your new Persona before the start of your next turn and the circumstances could be considered suspicious, you make a Contested Performance Check against their Insight in an attempt to fool them.

name: Action : Incapacitate
description: You attempt to apply a Tranquilizer Serum to a Beast, Humanoid or Monster by making a Contested Initiative Check. If successful, the Required Check on the Tranquilizer Serum is increased by 2. If you are Hidden, gain a 1d4 Bonus to your Initiatve Check and increase the Required Check on the Serum by 4.

name: Blown Cover
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed, +1 Acrobatics and +1 Dodge

name: Action [Daily] : Designitate Companion
description: You Choose an Ally with 10 Units and designate them as your Companion until a new one is picked using this Action again. When you or your Companion makes a Lifeline Check within 10 Units of each other, gain a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Helpful
description: Skill Checks that you Assist your Companion on do not suffer a Negative Modifier when failing and successful use of an Assisted Check adds a +3 Bonus Modifier instead of +2.

name: Empathetic
description: Gain +1 Insight and +1 Animals

name: Confidence in Allies
description: Your Companion gains a 1d4 Bonus to all Resistance Checks while within 15 Units of you.

name: Action : Coordinate
description: If your Companion is within 20 Units, you move their Initiative Order to yours. This can only be used once per Engagement.

name: Free Action : Coordinated Assault
description: Your Companion gains an extra 1d4 Attack Bonus to their next Weapon Attack.

name: Reaction : Motivate
description: Your Companion immediately takes an Action.

name: Wildborn
description: Gain +1 Animals and +1 Wilderness

name: Natural Weaponry
description: Gain +1 Damage to Crushing Weapons and you can Smith Crushing Weapons with Treated Wood in place of Steel Ingots.

name: Tracker
description: Gain +1 Search. Additionally, you can spend 10 Minutes examining an Area with a Radius of 20 Units to accurately determine what Beasts or Monsters passed through within the last day as well as acquiring their tracks.

name: Action [Daily] : One with Nature
description: After ending a Full Rest in Wilderness, gain Temporary Health equal to [Level]d4 that expire after your next Full Rest.

name: Proven Explorer
description: Become Good at Wilderness and learn a non-Magical Language

name: Reaction : Endurant Nature
description: In response to being forced to make a Resilience or Resist Check, add 1d6 to the Roll.

name: Healthy Living
description: Whenever consume an Object that restores Health, such as a healing potion or food, gain extra Health equal to your Wilderness Modifier.

name: Improved Firebomb Potions
description: Firebomb Potions you craft gain an additional die of Damage and deal an additional 1d8 Damage to Structures and Constructs.

name: Experimental Potions
description: Gain +1 Engineering and +1 Alchemy

name: Volatile Explosives
description: Increase the Radius of the Firebomb Potions and Explosive Ammunition you Craft by 1 Unit

name: Double Improved Firebombs
description: Add your Alchemy Bonus Modifier to the Damage your Firebomb Potions do at the time of Crafting.

name: Action : Timed Fuse
description: When you use a Potion, you can set a fuse, delaying the activation to the end of your Turn, 1 minute or 1 Hour.

name: Action : Precise Throw
description: You throw a Firebomb Potion. Any Creature that avoids the Attack takes Splash Damage.

name: Controlled Chemistry
description: Gain +5 Fire Mitigation. Additionally, you always succeed on Checks against your Firebomb Potions.

name: The Way of the Scout
description: Gain +1 Search and +1 Wilderness

name: Silent and Quick
description: Gain +1 Stealth and +1 Initiative

name: Surefooted
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed. When you make Checks against slipping from terrain or Spell effects, gain a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Nothing Left Unturned
description: Become Good at Search

name: Free Action : Mark
description: You pick a Target that you are aware of but do not need to have Line of Sight on. Any Bonuses from being Hidden, Having Partial Cover or being Invisible are negated until the Start of your next Turn. The first time this Target takes Damage, add an extra 1d8 of that Damage Type.

name: Action : Reveal
description: Make a Search Check that includes an Area around you with an 8 Unit Radius detecting any Hidden, Invisible or Creatures with Cover.

name: Reaction : Flanking Shot
description: When an Ally is Ajdacent to a Creature and makes an Attack with a Melee Weapon, you can make an Attack with an Ultra-Light or Light Ranged Weapon at that same Target.

name: The Way of the Battle Dancer
description: Gain +1 Athletics and +1 to Damage with Unarmed Strikes

name: Action : Circle Kick
description: Make an Unarmed Attack against a Creature. You can then Move up to your Movement Speed as long as remain Adjacent to your initial Target regardless if the Attack is successful. Your next Melee Attack this turn against a Creature other than the original Target has a 1d4 Attack Bonus.

name: Action : Sweeping Kick
description: Make a Contested Check against a Target one Size Larger than you or smaller using your Performance against their Acrobatics or Athletics Skill. If successful, the Creature becomes Prone and takes Physical Damage equal to the result of your Check.

name: Performer
description: Gain +1 Performance and +1 Acrobatics

name: Dancing Strikes
description: Gain +1 Attack with Unarmed Strikes

name: Elusive Dance
description: Gain +1 Dodge

name: Reaction : Lunging Kick
description: When an Ally within 4 Units is the Target of a Melee Attack, quickly dash without provoking Reactions to a Tile that is Adjacent to both your Ally and the provoking Creature and make an Unarmed Attack. If the Attack Hits, the Attacking Creature suffers a 1d4 Penalty to their Attack.

name: Area of Control
