description: Your Damage Die for Slashing Weapons are upgraded (1-Handed Light: 2d6, 1-Handed Heavy: 2d8, 2-Handed Light: 3d6, 2-Handed Heavy: 3d8)

name: Beginner Crusher
description: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Crushing Weapons. Gain a Fighting Stance.

name: Reaction : Flank
description: When an Allied Creature makes a Melee Attack against a target within your Melee Range, you can make an Attack against that same target with a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Increased Damage
description: Gain +1 Damage with Crushing Weapons

name: Novice Crusher
description: Gain +1 Attack with Crushing Weapons and Learn a Fighting Stance from the Stance Table

name: Action : Double Tap
description: Roll 2 Attack Dice and use the higher result. If one is a True Hit, add an additional 1d8 Damage to the Attack. If both are True Hits, add 3d8.

name: Reaction : Batter Aside
description: When a Creature makes a Melee Attack against you, make an Attack against them as a Reaction. If your Attack would hit, instead of dealing Damage, the Attack roll that triggered this Reaction takes a 1d4 penalty and cannot be used again until the start of your next turn.

name: Journeyman Crusher
description: Gain +1 Attack with Crushing Weapons and gain access to the Attack of Opportunity Reaction

name: Reaction : Kneecap
description: When a Creature moves out of your Area of Control willfully, make a Bludgeoning Attack against them. If the Attack hit, it lowers their Movement Speed by a number of Units equal to your Bludgeoning Damage Bonus Modifier, to a minimum of 2, until the start of their next turn.

name: Free Action : Forceful Blow
description: When you hit a Target with a Bludgeoning Weapon, deal extra Damage equal to your Strength Modifier.

name: Expert Crusher
description: Gain Critical Hits and Gain +1 Attack with Crushing Weapons

name: Action : Bludgeon
description: Make an Attack with a -1d4 Modifier.  If the Attack hits, the Target suffers a Penalty equal to your 1d4 roll to their Block, Dodge and Resistance until the start of your next turn.

name: Stunning Blow
description: Large and smaller Creatures that you score a True Hit on with Crushing Weapons give your target the Stunned Condition.

name: Master Crusher
description: Gain Brutal Critical Hits with Crushing Weapons and Gain +1 Attack with Crushing Weapons

name: Improvised Weapons
description: Any Object over 5 Mass or any Creature Grappled by you that is 2 Sizes Smaller or more, becomes a Crushing Weapon. A Creature held in this way takes Damage equal to your Crushing Damage Bonus Modifier when used to make an Attack.

name: Action : Power Crush
description: Make a Shove Attack against a Large or Smaller Creature. If Successful, you push the Creature Back 2 Units and Leap towards them and make a Weapon Attack with a +3 Attack Bonus.

name: Grandmaster Crusher
description: Your Damage Die for Crushing Weapons are upgraded (1-Handed Light: 2d6, 1-Handed Heavy: 2d8, 2-Handed Light: 3d6, 2-Handed Heavy: 3d8)

name: Beginner Piercer
description: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Piercing Weapons. Gain a Fighting Stance.

name: Reaction : Flank
description: When an Allied Creature makes a Melee Attack against a target within your Melee Range, you can make an Attack against that same target with a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Increased Damage
description: Gain +1 Damage with Piercing Weapons

name: Novice Piercer
description: Gain +1 Attack with Piercing Weapons and Learn a Fighting Stance from the Stance Table

name: Free Action : Puncture
description: After hitting a Character with a Piercing Weapon, force the target to roll a Resilience  Check against your total Damage dealt after Mitigation. If the target fails, they gain the Bleeding Condition

name: Action : Thrust
description: Make a normal Attack. Your next Attack with this same Weapon has a +2 Bonus to Attack until the start of your next turn regardless if your first Attack hits.

name: Journeyman Piercer
description: Gain +1 Attack with Piercing Weapons and gain access to the Attack of Opportunity Reaction

name: Reaction : Reactive Toss
description: When a Creature moves within 4 Units of you, you can throw a Light Piercing Weapon at them.

name: Action : Impale
description: You make an Attack against a Creature with a Heavy Piercing Weapon. The Creature must make an Acrobatics or Athletics check against your Strength Modifier. If they fail, they cannot move until the end of their next turn or you make another Attack with the same Weapon.

name: Expert Piercer
description: Gain Critical Hits and +1 Attack with Piercing Weapons

name: Action : Flurry
description: Make 3 Attacks with the same Piercing Weapon, but each Attack has a -2 Modifier to each Attack and cannot True Hit.

name: Action : Power Toss
description: Make a Throwing Weapon Attack with a 1 Handed Piercing Weapon at a -2 Modifier that is upgraded to a True Hit if it hits the Target.

name: Master Piercer
description: Gain Brutal Critical Hits with Piercing Weapons and Gain +1 Attack with Piercing Weapons

name: Precise
description: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Athletics

name: Action : Multi-thrust
description: Make 2 Attacks with a Piercing Weapon, each with a +2 Attack Bonus. If both Attacks hit, the Target gains the Bleeding Condition.

name: Grandmaster Piercer
description: Your Damage Die for Piercing Weapons are upgraded (1-Handed Light: 2d6, 1-Handed Heavy: 2d8, 2-Handed Light: 3d6, 2-Handed Heavy: 3d8)

name: Beginner Ranger
description: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Ranged Weapons

name: Distant Shooting
description: Gain +2 Maximum Units of Range on all Ranged Weapons

name: Increased Damage
description: Gain +1 Damage with Ranged Weapons

name: Novice Ranger
description: Increase Maximum range on all Ranged Weapons by 2 Units and reduce minimal range by 1 unit and gain +1 Attack with Ranged Weapons

name: Reaction : Cover Fire
description: If an Ally is being Attacked in range of your Ranged Weapon, you can shoot 3 Ammunition in quick succession at a Creature lowering their Attack roll by 1d4.

name: Stance of the Marksman
description: You learn the Marksmans Focus Stance

name: Journeyman Ranger
description: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Ranged Weapons

name: Action : Headshot
description: You make a Ranged Attack dealing an extra 1d10 Damage and increasing your True Hit threshold by 1. The bonus becomes 2d10 on a True Hit.

name: Action : Steady Aim
description: You gain a +2 Attack with Ranged Weapons until the end of your next turn. If you Move or are Displaced, this effect ends.

name: Expert Ranger
description: Gain Critical Hits and Gain +1 Attack with Ranged Weapons

name: Free Action : Shoot and Scoot
description: When you make a Ranged Attack, you can move 2 Units.

name: Action : Burst Shot
description: You shoot 3 of your ammunition in rapid succession, each with a -2 Attack Penalty. You can target seperate Creatures with this Attack

name: Master Ranger
description: Gain Brutal Critical Hits with Ranged Weapons and Gain +1 Attack and Damage with Ranged Weapons

name: Velocity
description: Gain +2 Maximum Units of Range on all Ranged Weapons and +1 Damage with Ranged Weapons

name: Action : Powershot
description: You make a Ranged Attack at half your normal Range. This shot gains a +3 Attack Modifier, your True Hit threshold is increased by 1, and the Damage bypasses Physical Mitigation.

name: Grandmaster Ranger
description: Your Damage Die for Ranged Weapons are upgraded (Ultra-Light Ranged: 1d10, Light Ranged: 2d6, Heavy Ranged 3d6)

name: Light Armored Fighting
description: Gain +1 Dodge and +1 Block while wearing Light Armor

name: Physical Defense
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation on all Light Armor

name: Elemental Defense
description: Gain +1 Elemental Mitigation on all Light Armor

name: Unencumbered Leather
description: Remove the Block and Dodge Penalties from Light Armor

name: Leatherworker
description: Gain +2 Smithing when crafting Light Armor

name: Freedom of Movement
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed

name: Improved Mitigation
description: Gain +2 Physical Mitigation on all Light Armor

name: Free Action : Quick Defense
description: You take the Defend Action by using a Free Action and gain an additional +1 Bonus to Defense Checks before the start of your next turn while wearing Light Armor.

name: Training Payoff
description: Gain +1 Stealth, +1 Acrobatics and +1 Athletics

name: Light Armor Expert
description: Gain +2 Elemental Mitigation and +1 Physical Mitigation on all Light Armor

name: Reaction: Reliable Dodge
description: When you take Damage, reduce it by half before calculating Mitigations.

name: Impact Protection
description: When you are hit by a Critical or Brutal Critical Hit, double your Physical Mitigation against the Damage.

name: Alternative Protection
description: Gain +4 Dark, Arcane and Divine Mitigation

name: Unburdened Dodge
description: Gain +1 Dodge and Immunity to the Prone condition

name: Glancing Blows
description: You gain a 1d4 Block and Dodge bonus against Projectile Attacks

name: Light Armor Master
description: Gain +2 Physical and +2 Elemental Mitigation while wearing Light Armor. Additionally, gain +1 Dodge, Block and Resistance.

name: Armored Fighting
description: Gain +1 Dodge and +1 Block while wearing Medium and Heavy Armor

name: Physical Defense
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation on all Medium and Heavy Armor

name: Elemental Defense
description: Gain +1 Elemental Mitigation while wearing Medium and Heavy Armor

name: Improved Mitigation
description: Gain +1 Physical and +1 Elemental Mitigation on all Medium and Heavy Armor

name: Efficient Movement
description: Remove the Stealth Penalty and gain +1 Dodge while wearing Medium and Heavy Armor

name: Toughened
description: Gain +1 Resilience and +1 Strength

name: Unencumbered
description: Remove 1 Level of Casting Penalty from Medium and Heavy Armor and gain +1 Block and +1 Dodge while wearing Medium or Heavy Armor.

name: Action : Charging Sprint
description: You can move your Movement Speed plus an additional 2 Units but you can only move in a straight line. If you collide with any Creature your size or smaller, you can make a Shove Attack against them. Until you fail a Shove Attack, you can continue to move in the straight line.

name: Surprisingly Nimble
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed while wearing Medium or Heavy Armor and +1 Acrobatics

name: Armored Expert
description: Gain +2 Physical and +1 Elemental Mitigation on all Medium and Heavy Armor

name: Free Action : Counterguard
description: You make an Attack with a melee weapon without applying your damage bonus modifier. If the attack hits, it counts as if you had taken the Defense Action until the start of your next turn.

name: Reaction : Versatile Armor
description: In response to taking any Damage type besides Psychic and True Damage, further reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Physical Mitigation.

name: Metal Skin
description: You have Immunity to the Dazed condition and gain +1 Block and +2 Physical Mitigation

name: Reflective Surface
description: Gain +3 Arcane Mitigation and +1 Resistance

name: Free Action : Body Check
description: Make a Shove Attack by using your body, dealing Damage equal to your Physical Mitigation regardless if you succeed or not.

name: Master Armorer
description: Gain +1 Block, +1 Dodge, +1 Resist while wearing Armor and Gain +1 Movement Speed

name: Unarmored Fighting
description: Gain +1 Dodge and +1 Block while not wearing armor

name: Hardened Skin
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation while not wearing armor

name: Quick Footed
description: Gain +1 Acrobatics and +1 Movement Speed

name: Peak Performance
description: Gain +1 Acrobatics, +1 Athletics and +1 Physical Mitigation while not wearing armor

name: Psychic Defense
description: Gain +4 Psychic Mitigation

name: Magical Defense
description: Gain +4 Arcane Mitigation

name: Tough Hide
description: Gain +1 Physical and Elemental Mitigation while not wearing armor

name: Action : Sprint
description: You move a distance equal to double your Movement Speed. While sprinting in this way, you gain +2 Block and Dodge against any provoked Reactions.

name: Ray Avoidance
description: You can use your Dodge Skill to attempt to avoid Rays instead of Resistance.

name: Unarmored Expert
description: Gain +1 Dodge, +1 Resist and +1 Block while not wearing armor. Additionally, gain +1 Movement Speed.

name: Reaction : Rollout
description: In response to being Targeted by an Area, Line or Cone ability, you can immediately move up to 2 Units. If you are no longer within the Area, you automatically succeed on the Defense Check and avoid any Splash Damage, otherwise you gain a +3 Bonus to your Check.

name: Free Action : Unencumbered Attack
description: You make an Attack with a Light or Ultra Light Weapon as a Free Action while not wearing Armor.

name: Magical Skin
description: Gain +2 Dark, Divine and Elemental Mitigation

name: Action : Tactical Retreat
description: Make an Attack with a Melee Weapon. Regardless if the Attack hits or misses, you can move 3 Units without provoking Reactions. If the Attack is a True Hit, you can move up to your Movement Speed

name: Reaction : Versatile Reaction
description: You can use one of your unique Reactions without expending one of its charges.

name: Master of Body
description: Gain +1 Dodge, Block and Resist while not wearing Armor. Additionally, gain +1 Movement Speed, +1 Physical Mitigation and +1 Elemental Mitigation.

name: Vampiric Thrall
description: You have vampirism and are the thrall to some Vampire Lord. You are considered permanently Charmed by them.

name: Anatomical Changes
description: Your vampirism has manifested in several changes to your physique. Gain +1 Acrobatics and +1 Strength.

name: Place of Rest
description: You designate a coffin or similar storage Object and fill it with dirt. When you complete a Full Rest within the Object, you recover all your Health and remove any Condition on you.

name: Deadskin
description: Gain +1 Physical and +2 Dark Mitigation.

name: Wallclimb
description: You gain a Climbing Speed equal to your Movement Speed and climb vertical and horizontal surfaces.

name: Daywalker
description: The amount of Damage you take while ending your turn in sunlight is reduced to 1d4 True Damage.

name: Manifesting Vampirism
description: Your powers continue to manifest. You gain Echolocation up to 8 Units and become Immune to Disease and Poison.

name: Deadly Fangs
description: Your Vampire Bite Action deals an additional 1d10 Damage.

name: Action : Bat Swarm
description: You turn into a Swarm of Bats for up to 1 Hour, inheriting their Statblock. The Swarm only recovers Health at the end of a Full Rest and if it reaches 0, you cannot use this Action again until the swarm is restored. You revert back to your original form if the swarm reaches 0 Health or you use this Action again.

name: Free Action : Regeneration
description: After consuming blood from a Humanoid or Beast, either with the Vampire Bite Action or drinking from a container, you gain 2d4 Health. After using this ability, your blood requirements are no longer satisifed for the day.

name: Exotic Blood
description: Gain +1 Alchemy. Additionally, your blood counts as a Tier 1 Augmentation for Alchemy.

name: Vampire Charm
description: Gain +1 Persuasion. When a Humanoid Botches an Insight Check against your Persuasion, they become Charmed by you until it breaks naturally.

name: Ascension
description: You become freed from the thrall of your master and become a Vampire Lord. Your Bite Attack now functions to infect Humanoids with Vampirism if they fail a Resilience Check with your Level as the Required Check, turning them into your Thrall if they die within 1 Week of being bitten. You can maintain 1 Thrall, increasing to 2 at Level 11, and 3 at level 15.

name: Action : Vampire Bite
description: You make an Unarmed Attack against another Creature. If the Target is a Beast or Humanoid and the Damage is not completely Mitigated, you gain Health equal to the damage dealt and have your blood requirements satisifed.

name: Vampire
description: You are afflicted with Vampirism and suffer the benefits and weaknesses, changing from the Humanoid to Undead Creature Type. You have a -5 Divine Mitigation penalty and take 1d12 True Damage at the end of each turn while in Sunlight. You do not need to eat, drink or breathe and do not get the benefits from consuming foods or potions. For each day that you do not consume at least a vial of Blood, you gain 1 Tier of Exhaustion at the end of a Full Rest which cannot be mitigated by Spells or Immunities.

name: Tearing Claws
description: While you are in Lycanthrope form, your claws count as Light 1 Handed Slashing Weapons and cause the Bleeding Condition on a True Hit.

name: Wild Tracker
description: Your Lycanthropy has manifested in innate hunting skills. Gain +1 Search and +1 Wilderness

name: Calming Allies
description: Despite your savagery, you are still receptive to intervention from allies. While in Lycanthropy form, an Ally can use an Action to attempt to calm you down by making a Contested Persuasion Check against your Resilience. If they succeed, you lose any Maddened Condition affecting you. If they succeed with a result of 15 or higher, you revert back to your original form.

name: Beastial Manifestations
description: Your Lycanthropy has advanced to a point where your body is subtly transformed. Gain +2 Cold Mitigation, +1 Strength and +1 Acrobatics.

name: Action : Lunge
description: While in Lycanthrope Form, you leap from a standing position a distance equal to your Athletics Modifier and make an Attack with one of your Claws.

name: Free Action : Blood Trail
description: While in Lycanthrope Form, you Move up to your Movement Speed towards a Creature that has the Bleeding or Wounded Condition.

name: Inner Beast
description: Gain +1 Resilience, +1 Athletics and +1 Damage with Slashing Weapons

name: Reaction : Resist
description: After being forced to make a Resilience Check, add 1d6 to your Check.

name: Action [Daily] : Alphahowl
description: While in Lycanthrope form, you let loose a devastating howl by making an Animals Check. Any hostile Beast within 20 Units must make a Resilience Check greater than or equal to your Animals Check or become Afraid of you. At the end of each turn, they can attempt to make the Check again against the initial Animals Check. Otherwise, the Afraid Condition lasts for 1 minute.

name: Fortified
description: When you transform into a Lycanthrope, the Temporary Health you gain is doubled.

name: Free Action : Offhand Claw
description: When you make an Attack with one of your claws while in Lycanthropy Form, you can make an additional Attack with your offhand.

name: Overcome Weakness
description: Your strength with your inner beast has grown to a point where you can remove your Lycanthropy Weakness Trait.

name: Action [Daily] : Controlled Transformation
description: When a Creature has the Bleeding Condition within 20 Units if you, can you willfully transform into a Lycanthrope without making a Check or be subjected to the Maddened Condition.

name: Action : Lycanthrope Bite
description: While in Lycanthrope form, You make an Unarmed Attack against a Creature that deals an additional 1d10 Physical Damage. A Creature must make a Resilience Check against the total Physical Damage dealt after Mitigation or become Diseased. If the Disease Creature is a Humanoid and they are not cured within 1d20 days, they are inflicted with Lycanthropy.

name: Lycanthrope
description: You are afflicted with Lycanthropy and suffer the benefits and weaknesses. Whenever you are the Target of a True Hit, you must make a Resilience Check against half the total Damage taken after Mitigation or transform into your Lycanthrope Form, gaining Temporary Health equal to your Level and losing the ability to Speak. If there is a Creature within 20 Units has the Bleeding Condition, you become Maddened, which cannot be avoided or removed by any spells, immunities or effects. You remain in this form until you reach 0 Health, at which point you revert back to your original form, gain 1 Tier of Exhaustion, and make a LIfeline Check. The Lycanthrope transformation lasts 1d6 hours and you cannot transform again until you complete a Full Rest.

name: Contracted
description: Additionally, you learn 4 Beginner Spells from your Patron's school of magic

name: Martial Knowledge
description: Gain +1 Damage to all Melee Weapons and +1 Strength

name: Arcane Knowledge
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage and +1 Arcanum

name: Guiding Hand
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 to Melee Attacks.

name: Gift of Focus
description: Gain +1 Concentration and Immunity to the Charmed Condition

name: Gift of Comprehension
description: Learn the Magical Language of your Patron and gain +1 Insight

name: Improved Pact
description: Learn 4 Novice Level Spells of your Patron's school of magic and gain a Pact Familiar.

name: Action : Infused Weapon
description: You make a Weapon Attack but convert the Primary Damage to Arcane Damage. If you are fully aligned with your Patron, you gain a 1d4 Bonus to your Attack Roll.

name: Free Action : Infused Spell
description: You Charge a Spell from your Patron's school of magic. If you are not fully aligned with your Patron, your Spell Attack has a 1d4 penalty.

name: Journeyman Pact Magic
description: Learn 4 Journeyman Level Spells of your Patron's school of magic and gain +1 Spell Attack.

name: Enhanced Core
description: Gain +12 Power and +12 Power Regeneration

name: Reaction : Planar Defense
description: In response to being targeted by an Attack, make a Persuasion Check instead of your normal Defense Check. On a success, your Patron defends you from the Attack and you take no Damage.

name: Pact Bound
description: Learn 4 Expert Level Spells of your Patron's School of Magic, At level 10, learn 2 Master Spells of your Patron's schools of magic. Additionally, gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Reaction [Daily] : Favor of the Patron
description: In response to making any Skill Check, add 2d4 to the result. This is decreased to a 1d4 if you have negative alignment with your Patron and does not add any bonus if you have -3 alignment.

name: Pact Alignment
description: Your Patron lends you power with the expectation that your actions will align with their interests. You start your Pact fully aligned with your Patron. When you defy the wishes of your Patron, you lose an alignment, up to a maximum of 3. For each alignment you lose, your Spell Attacks from your Patron's School of Magic suffer a -1 Attack Penalty. At -3 alignment, you can no longer Channel Spells from your Patron's School. Alignment can be restored by fulfilling tasks for your Patron or taking significant actions that please them.

name: Anatomical Expertise
description: Gain +1 Medicine and +2 Health

name: In Good Health
description: Gain +1 Resilience and +1 Physical Mitigation

name: Veterinarian
description: Gain +1 Animals and you can use your Medic Skills that target Humanoids on Beasts.

name: Action : Stabilize
description: You quickly apply a Sterile Bandage to a Creature, ending any Bleeding Condition and causing them to not lose Lifeline Points at the end of their turn while in Lifeline unless they take Damage.

name: Pharmacist
description: Gain +1 Academics and +1 Alchemy

name: Bedside Manner
description: Gain +1 Insight and +1 Medicine

name: Treat Wounds
description: You spend 1 minute treating a Humanoid or Beast, restoring Health equal to a Medicine Check and using a Sterile Bandage. A Creature can only be affected by this ability once per Full Rest.

name: Action : Resuscitate
description: If a Humanoid has been dead for less than 1 minute and is not missing any vital organs, you can attempt to revive them with a Cumulative Medicine Check of 28 over 3 Checks

name: Action : Bloodletting
description: Using a blade, you give a Creature the Bleeding Condition by making a small cut. If this is used in a hostile way, make a normal Attack with a Light Piercing or Slashing Weapon and foce the Target to make a Resilience Check against the Physical Damage dealt after Mitigation. If the Creature Bleeds for 4 turns, they are cured of any Disease or Poison affecting them.

name: Triage
description: You spend 10 Minutes tending to up to 5 allies, restoring Health equal to 1d12 + a Medicine Check by using a number of Sterile Bandages equal to the number of Creatures being treated. A Creature can only be affected by this ability once per day.

name: Reaction : Damage Control
description: Using your knowledge of Medicine and Anatomy, when you take Physical Damage, you can reduce it by half before applying Mitigations.

name: Diagnosis
description: When you restore a Creatures Health with Treat Wounds or Triage, you also remove any Blindness, Deafness or Wounded Condition from them.

name: Embodiment of Health
description: Gain +5 Health and +2 Medicine

name: Vital Spot
description: The True Hit threshold on your Weapon Attacks is increased by 1

name: Placebo Effect
description: Whenever you restore Health or remove a Condition from a Creature, they receive Temporary Health equal to your Level.

name: Master Healer
description: The limits on how many times you can treat a Creature with Triage and Treat Wounds are removed

name: Ballads
description: You gain the ability to play Ballads which require an Action to start and your Focus to maintain which affect anyone within 4 Units who can hear. Learn 1 Ballad of your choice.

name: Showmanship
description: You become Good at the Performance Skill

name: Prodigy
description: Gain +1 Concentration and +1 Academics

name: Growing Repertoire
description: Learn 2 Ballads

name: Reaction : Segue
description: You seamlessly change the Ballad you are playing which takes effect immediately.

name: Free Action : Attacca
description: You quickly start a new Ballad

name: Reaction : Motif
description: You Target an allied Creature who can hear a Ballad you are playing and use one of their listed Reactions. This does not count against their usage limit or consume their Reaction for this round.

name: Immune to Critique
description: Gain +1 Resistance and +2 Psychic Mitigation

name: Versatile Musician
description: Learn 2 Ballads

name: Medley
description: While you are Focusing on a Ballad, you can use another Action to start an additional Ballad. If you lose your Focus on one, both end.

name: Reaction : Inspire
description: As a Reaction to a Creature who can hear your Ballad making a Defense, Attack or Skill Check, add 1d4 to that Check. If you are Good at Performance, add 1d6 instead.

name: Action : Dissonance
description: You suddenly end a Ballad with a harsh note or chord, forcing all Creatures that can hear your Ballad to make a Resistance Check against your Performance Check or take Psychic Damage equal to your Performance Check

name: Reaction : Resonating Powerchord
description: You finish a Ballad you have been playing for one or more rounds with an expert powerchord. This causes the effect of your Ballad to last 1 minute instead of ending instantly.

name: Action : Accelerando
description: You speed up a Ballad you are currently playing, granting all allies who can hear it an additional Free Action until the start of your next turn.

name: Star of the Show
description: Gain +1 Performance, +1 Persuasion and +4 Psychic Mitigation

name: Masterpiece
description: Learn 1 Masterpiece Ballad

name: Beginner Engineering
description: Gain +2 Engineering

name: Tinkerer
description: Gain +1 Smithing and +1 Ammocraft

name: Superior Tools
description: Lock Picks, Compasses, Crowbars and Climbing Kits you craft add a 1d4 Bonus instead of +1

name: Craft : Strong Start
description: You can reroll your first Crafting Skill Check when attempting to create an Object that has a Cumulative Check.

name: Action : Undermine
description: You interact with an Object or Structure, examining it for weaknesses by making an Engineering Check. On an 11 or higher, you lower the Durability Tier by 1 for a minute. You can only attempt to Undermine a unique Object or Structure once per Day.

name: Disarming
description: You gain a 1d4 Bonus to disarming and defending against Traps

name: Novice Engineering
description: Gain +1 Engineering and +1 Academics

name: Locksmith
description: You are a master Locksmith, gaining a +2 Bonus when using Lockpicks and increasing the Required Check to open any Locks you Craft by an amount equal to your Engineering Bonus Modifier.

name: Trapmaster
description: Traps you make have the Required Checks for spotting and avoiding them increased by 2 at the time you craft them. Additionally, add an extra Dice to the Damage of your Traps.

name: Upgrades
description: You are able to add one unique Infusion onto Weapons, Armor, Gloves or Boots after they have been Crafted, requiring an Engineering Check of 12 or higher or the materials are lost.

name: Inventor
description: You can install Grapple, Net and Bola Launcher Infusions on hand armor. Additionally, each infusion has its Range increased by 2 Units.

name: Craft : Reverse Engineer
description: You choose an Object that has a Crafting Recipe and attempt to deconstruct it. Roll an Engineering Check. If the Check is above a 14, you recover all the ingredients. On a success, if you recreate this Object on the same day, you gain a +3 Bonus on your first Craft Check.

name: Free Action : Use
description: You can interact with an object without expending an Action on your turn.

name: Precise Fabrication
description: Ranged Weapons that you Craft gain +1 Attack and +2 Units of Maximum Range.

name: Construct Crafting
description: You can create Constructs of the Mechanical subtype up to a Level less than your Engineering Bonus Modifier. For each Level of the Target Construct, you must spend 1 Day and 100 Gold for parts and fabrication

name: Master Engineer
description: You Gain +2 Engineering and Infusions, including those from other Crafting Skills, no longer add to the Cumulative Check of an item.

name: Beginner Alchemist
description: Gain +2 Alchemy

name: Deadly Poisons
description: Your Poison recipes gain an extra dice of damage.

name: Improved Healing Potions
description: Your Healing Potion recipes gain an extra dice of Health restored.

name: Careful Chemist
description: Gain +1 Alchemy, +1 Concentration and increase the Required Checks against Potions you Craft by 1.

name: Non-Lethal Poisons
description: You can modify a Poison you are crafting to not deal fatal damage, and instead cause a Creature to become Unconscious for a number of hours equal to your Alchemy Bonus Modifier when they reach 0 Health.

name: Expanded Volatility
description: Potions you craft that specify a radius have that radius increased by 1 unit

name: Potent Potions
description: Healing Potions you craft heal for an additional amount of Health equal to your alchemy bonus modifier at the time of crafting. Additioanlly, Poisons you craft deal additional damage equal to half your alchemy bonus modifier.

name: Free Action : Apply Poison
description: You quickly apply a Vial of Poison to a Weapon or Piece of Ammunition.

name: Action : Toss Potion
description: As an action, you can toss a Potion to a friendly Creature within 6 units. They can use their Reaction to immediately consume the potion.

name: Advanced Alchemy
description: Gain +1 Alchemy and access to Alchemy Augmentations

name: Efficient Mixing
description: You Overcraft on Alchemy recipes when you roll an 11 or 12 and you produce 2 potions instead of 1.

name: Bolstering Potions
description: Your healing Potions grant Temporary Health that lasts until the end of the next Full Rest if a Creature consumes one while at Full Health.

name: Concentrated Potions
description: Gain +1 Alchemy. The Required Checks against Potions you Craft is increased by 2.

name: Taste Tester
description: Gain an Immunity to Poison and +2 Resilience

name: Free Action : Chug
description: You can quickly consume a Potion, not counting against the amount of objects you can consume on a given turn.

name: Master Alchemist
description: Gain +2 Alchemy and an extra dice on Poisons, Healing Potions and Potions with damaging effects on your alchemy recipes.

name: Beginner Chef
description: Gain +2 Cooking

name: Snack Crafter
description: Add 1 Dice to any Temporary Health bonuses provided by consuming Snacks cooked by you.

name: Meal Crafter
description: Add 1 Dice to any Health recovery bonuses provided by consuming Meals cooked by you.

name: Mixologist
description: Gain +1 Alchemy and +1 Cooking

name: Spice Up Your Life
description: Gain +1 Resilience and +2 Fire Mitigation

name: Salvager
description: Whenever you fail making a Snack or Meal, you can make one additional attempt before losing all the ingredients.

name: Fortifying Food
description: Anyone who consumes a Snack or Meal cooked by you gains +1 Resistance and Power equal to your Cooking Modifier the next time they take a Breather. A creature can only benefit from this once per day and it expires after their next Full Rest.

name: Efficient Chef
description: You create twice the amount of Snacks and Meals with the same amount of ingredients and time.

name: Hide with Flavor
description: You can combine a Potion with a Meal or Snack. When a Creature consumes the Meal or Snack, they gain the effects of the Potion. If the effect is negative and has a Required Check to avoid, that Check is increased by 2.

name: Advanced Cooking
description: Gain +1 Cooking and access to Cooking Augmentations

name: Reaction : Lucky Pan
description: When you are forced to make a Block Check, add a +3 if you have a Cooking Pan in your inventory.

name: Healthy Eating, Healthy Life
description: Gain +5 Health

name: Critical Cook
description: Gain +1 Cooking. When you Overcraft on a Cooking Check, your Cooking Modifier is doubled when it is applied to bonuses on your Meals and Snacks.

name: Nutritionist
description: Gain +1 Alchemy, +1 Medicine and +1 Cooking.

name: Good Food, Sweet Dreams
description: Anyone who consumes a Meal cooked by you gets credit for Favorable Rest no matter the conditions. Additionally, they recover extra Power on their Conduit equal to your Cooking Modifier.

name: Perfect Meals
description: Gain +1 Cooking. Any Meal or Snack created by you always gives the maximum amount of Temporary Health, Health Recovery and Healing instead of rolling.

name: Beginner Smith
description: Gain +2 Smithing

name: Hard Labor
description: Gain +1 Strength and +2 Health

name: Smithing Hammer
description: Gain +1 Damage with Crushing Weapons

name: Reaction : Brace
description: If you are hit with a Melee Attack, you can temporarily increase your Physical Mitigation by your Smithing Skill until the start of your next turn. Also add your Smithing Skill to any Checks that involve Displacing you or knocking you Prone.

name: Improved Weapons
description: Weapons you Craft gain a +1 Damage Bonus

name: Improved Armor
description: Chest Armor you Craft gains +1 Physical Mitigation

name: Metalworker
description: Gain +1 Smithing, +1 Engineering and add an extra Infusion on Chest Armor and Weapons you Craft

name: Craft : Smelt
description: You can destroy a Weapon or Armor that has a Smithing Recipe in a Forge yielding the Metal Ingots listed in the base Ingredients.

name: Efficient Metallurgy
description: When you fail to Craft an Object with Smithing, you do not lose any of the Ingots associated with the Recipe.

name: Advanced Smithing
description: Gain +1 Smithing and access to Smithing Augmentations

name: Craft : Precision Forging
description: You add an additional 1d4 Bonus to a Smithing Check but the Object can no longer benefit from Overcrafting. This can be used multiple times per Object.

name: Craft : Limit Testing
description: Once per Object, you can use a Superior Infusion, doubling the required materials and bonuses for either a Reinforced or Insulating Infusion but not increasing the maximum Required Check to successfully complete it.

name: Perfectly Balanced
description: Melee Weapons you Craft gain a +1 Attack Bonus and Chest Armor gains +1 Elemental Mitigation.

name: Free Action : Sunder
description: When you hit a Creature with a Melee Weapon they become vulnerable. The next time the Targeted Creature takes Physical Damage, make a Smithing Check and apply that Damage to the total.

name: Forged in Fire
description: Gain +1 Athletics, +1 Resilience and +4 Fire Mitigation

name: Master Smith
description: Gain +2 Smithing. Gloves and Boots Crafted by you gain +1 Elemental and +1 Physical Mitigation. Helmets Crafted by you grant Immunity to the Dazed Condition.

name: Beginner Runecarving
description: Gain +2 Runecarving

name: Unyielding Light
description: Your Light Rune does not expire and can be activated and deactivated indefinitely.

name: Shared Words
description: You can teach others your Command Words for runes, allowing them to activate them.

name: Craft : Efficient Powdered Metal
description: You Grind an Ingot to Dust in half the amount of time and create 14 Pinches instead of 10

name: Magical Script
description: Gain +1 Runecarving and +1 Scribing

name: Automatic Return
description: Your Return Rune no longer requires a Command Word to return to you. any Object with this rune can return to you at the start of your next turn if it is more than 1 Unit away and within the Range of the Rune.

name: Runekeeper
description: Gain +1 Runecarving and +1 Arcanum

name: Volatile Runes
description: Your Breaking Runes deal an extra dice of Damage, deal bonus Damage equal to your Runecarving Modifier and deal Splash Damage in a 1 Unit Radius.

name: Craft : Steady Hand
description: You carve a Rune that has a craft time of 1 minute and instead spend 10 Minutes and double the amount of materials but add a 1d6 Bonus to your Craft Check.

name: Attention to Detail
description: Gain +1 Runecarving, +1 Scribing and +1 Concentration

name: Action : Arcane Break
description: You either throw an Object with a Breaking Rune on it or activate it with your command word. Instead of dealing Physical Damage, the rune deals Arcane Damage instead.

name: Reaction : Command Word
description: You can activate Runes that require a Command Word with a Reaction.

name: Expert Runecarver
description: Gain +1 Runecarving and +2 Arcane Mitigation. Your Trigger Rune can activate Journeyman and Expert Scrolls.

name: Enchanter
description: You gain access to the Enchanting Prestige Recipes

name: Dermaglyph Artist
description: You gain access to the Dermaglyph Prestige Recipes

name: Master Runecarver
description: Gain +2 Runecarving. Your Efficient Powdered Metal skill causes you to create 20 Pinches instead of 14 and your Breaking Runes deal an extra Dice of Damage. Additionally, you can carve your Breaking Rune into a Beginner Catalyst, causing it to deal the Damage Type of the Catalyst instead of Physical.

name: Beginner Scribe
description: Gain +2 Scribing. You can Scribe Beginner and Novice Spells to Scrolls.

name: Mass Production
description: Gain +1 Initiative. You can use a Piece of Paper instead of Treated Parchment when Researching and Scribing Spells, but you have a -1 Penalty to your Scribe Check.

name: Deceiving Penmanship
description: Gain +1 Thievery. Forgeries that you make are indistinguishable if you possess a reference to the writing you are trying to mimic.

name: Master of the Quill
description: You Gain +1 Scribing, +1 Runecarving and +1 Academics

name: Chronicler
description: As part of taking a Full Rest, you spend 1 Hour journaling the events of the day that you can reference accurately in the future by consulting the journal. Additionally, you can recall any writing or symbols you have read, even if it is in a Language you do not understand.

name: Reaction : Field Research
description: When a Creature Channels a Spell within 10 Units of you that you can See and Hear, you use your Reaction to attempt to jot down a quick note about the Spell. If you Research this Spell in the future, you gain a +2 Bonus to your Scribe Check and use a Powdered Metal of one tier less than the one required.

name: Researcher
description: Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Scribing

name: Embedded Components
description: You can Scribe Scrolls that consume Components by adding the Component as an Ingredient in your Recipe.

name: Instructions Included
description: When others use Scrolls you Scribed, the Scrolls have a Spell Attack of 3 and a Spell Damage Bonus Modifier equal to your Scribing Skill at the time of the Check.

name: Improved Scribing
description: Gain +1 Scribing. You can Scribe Journeyman Spells that you have access.

name: Action : Perfect Recital
description: You Channel a Scroll that requires one Action but use your Scribe Bonus as both the Spell Attack and double your Scribe Bonus as the Spell Damage Bonus Modifier.

name: Ritualistic Scribing
description: You can Scribe Spells that have a Channel Time of more than 1 minute.

name: Expert Scribe
description: Gain +1 Scribing. You can Scribe Expert Spells that you have access to and Use Expert Scrolls.

name: Taboo Magic
description: Pick an Exotic Magic type. You can Research and Scribe Spells from that School.

name: Collector of Knowledge
description: You can Research and Scribe Journeyman or lower Spells from any Traditional School of Magic.

name: Master Scribe
description: Gain +2 Scribing. You can Scribe Master and Grand Master Spells that you have access to and use Master Scrolls. Additionally, when you fail to Scribe Check to Scribe a Spell, you can attempt the Recipe one more time by using another Treated Parchment

name: Beginner Ammocrafter
description: Gain +2 Ammocraft

name: Critical Success
description: When you Overcraft, you produce double the amount of Ammunition

name: Trajectory Analysis
description: Gain Additional [Heavy +3 / Light +2 / Ultra Light +1] Range on Ranged Weapons

name: Ammunition Specialist
description: Gain +1 Ammocraft and +1 Damage to Ranged Weapons

name: Free Action : Pass Through
description: When you shoot a piece of your Ammunition, you turn it into a Line Attack that deals full Damage to the first target hit, and half to every other target it passes through.

name: Volatile Ammunition
description: Your Shrapnel and Exploding Ammunition deals an extra dice of Damage

name: Trajectory Analysis
description: Gain +1 Attack to Ranged Weapons

name: Packed Ammunition
description: The Radius on Ammunition Infusions that cause Area effects is increased by 1 Unit

name: Improved Ammunition Chamber
description: You can apply an Ammunition Chamber Infusion to a Weapon that has already been Crafted without requiring an Infusion Slot by making an Ammocraft Check of 10 or Higher.

name: Handloader
description: Gain +1 Ammocraft, +1 Initiative and +1 Engineering

name: Armor Negation
description: Armor Piercing Ammunition created by you bypasses Physical Mitigation Completely.

name: Potion Lobber
description: Your Delivery Ammunition does not have a Penalty to the Required Check to avoid it and the Range is extend to the Maximum Range of a Weapon.

name: Expert Ammocrafter
description: Gain +2 Ammocraft and +1 Damage to Ranged Weapons

name: Improved Utility
description: When you create Ammunition with the Shrapnel, Explosive or Smokescreen Infusions, the initial Projectile now deals Damage like a normal Ranged Attack if you hit a Creature.

name: Action : Ammosurge
description: You prepare 4 Ammunition which are all consumed by this Action. You fire 1d4 times ignoring any Ammunition Capacity property and do not apply your Bonus Damage Modifier to any of the hits.

name: Master Ammocrafter
description: Gain +2 Ammocraft. Your Shrapnel and Explosive Ammo add your Ammocraft Skill at the time of Crafting to their Splash Damage. Additionally, the execution threshold on your Executioner Infusion is doubled.

name: Summoner
description: Gain the Summoner Familiar

name: Free Action : Greater Summoning
description: Instead of using a quartz worth 5gp and an action, you can utilize a beginner catalyst gem to summon the corresponding elemental. When summoned this way, the elemental gains Temporary Health equal to your level. This ability can also be used to summon a higher level elemental using the Master Summoner trait with the appropriate catalyst.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: You spend 1 minute and designate a weapon as your elemental weapon. When you have an active summon, the weapon's primary damage is converted to the damage type of the corresponding elemental and gains the magical property. You can only have one elemental weapon at a time.

name: Elemental Magic
description: Gain +1 Arcanum and +1 Spell Damage

name: Reaction : Divert Elements
description: In response to taking elemental, arcane or physical damage when you have an active summon, you add their mitigation to yours when calculating damage.

name: Free Action : Focused Elements
description: When you have an active elemental and channel an evocation spell of the subschool of your elemental, it becomes charged, has it's true hit threshold increased and can critically hit.

name: Master Summoner
description: Your summoning skills allow you to use an action to transform your familiar into an elementaling by using a 50gp gem or catalyst or an Elemental by using a 300gp gem or catalyst. This can only be used to summon an elemental that is lower than your level.

name: Adaptive Shield
description: When using a shield as your Conduit, your shield offers adaptive mitigation against a single damage type equal to your spell damage bonus modifier. In response to taking arcane, dark, divine or elemental damage, you can elect to spend 1 power to change your adaptive mitigation to that type for the next minute.

name: Free Action : Shield Charge
description: Immediately after Channeling a Spell and while you have an active adaptive mitigation, the Spell becomes Charged but you lose the adaptive Mitigation.

name: Reaction : Retaliatory Spell
description: In response to being attacked by a Melee Attack by an Adjacent Creature, retaliate with a Touch Spell against the attacking Creature using your Block Check against the attack as the Spell Attack.

name: Magus
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Improved Adaptive Shield
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage. Additionally, your Adaptive Shield trait no longer requires power and does not expire.

name: Action : Spellburst
description: While using your shield as a Conduit, you channel a Ray Spell that takes 1 Action but it is converted to a 1 Unit wide Line Spell instead.

name: Arcane Aegis
description: Gain +1 Block while wielding a Shield, +2 Arcane Mitigation and +1 Elemental Mitigation.

name: Masochist
description: Your Maximum Health is increased in an amount equal to your Level, but you can no longer benefit from Temporary Health.

name: Free Action : Reckless Onslaught
description: You leap up to your Jump distance. If your next Melee Attack hits on this turn, it is upgraded to a True Hit. Until the start of your next turn, the first Melee Attack that hits you is also upgraded to a True Hit.

name: Action : Anguishing Strike
description: You make an Attack with a melee weapon that deals an additional 1d8 Primary Damage if you are below your Maximum Health. This bonus is increaesd to 2d8 when below half your Maximum Health, and 4d8 while in lifeline.

name: Chase the Pain
description: While at or below half your maximum Health, you gain a 1d4 bonus to Melee Attacks but have a 1d4 Penalty when at your Health maximum.

name: Focused Agony
description: Gain +1 Concentration. Additionally, While you are below half Health, you are immune to the Confused, Dazed and Stunned conditions.

name: Savored Death
description: Gain +1 Resilience. Additionally, when you enter lifeline, you gain a Heroic Action.

name: Reaction : Pain Threshold
description: In response to taking Damage, make a Resilience Check and reduce the damage by that amount. If you are below half your maximum Health before taking the damage, this does not count against your unique Reaction limit.

name: Arcanatech
description: Gain Access to Arcanatech Crafting. You can use Beginner and Novice Level Catalysts in your Arcanatech Recipes.

name: Craft : Acceleration Theory
description: When you apply your first Arcanatech Infusion to a Ranged Weapon, that weapon gains a +1 to Attack and +1 to Damage.

name: Compounded Magic
description: You can add an additional Infusion to any Arcanatech Enhancements you Craft.

name: Tinkerer's Hands
description: Gain +1 Smithing, +1 Engineering and +1 Initiative

name: Arcanatech Catalyst Expert
description: Gain +1 Spell Damage. Additionally, Catalysts that you create count as 1 tier higher for the purpose of Arcanatech Recipes.

name: Exo-Enhancements
description: Your Aracanatech Enhancements can be installed seamlessly on top of their organic counterparts, mitigating the need to remove body parts. Enhancements installed in this way do not cause the penalty to maximum Health.

name: Improved Arcanatech
description: Gain +1 Engineering. Additionally, you can use Journeyman Catalysts in your Arcanatech Recipes at Level 7, Expert at 9 and Master at 11.

name: Natural Magic
description: You cannot benefit from a conduit, but instead become your own conduit, gaining a base power and power regeneration equal to double your level.

name: Free Action : Amplify
description: After Channeling a Spell, spend an additional 1 power to charge it

name: Magical Instinct
description: Gain +1 Initiative and +1 Spell Damage

name: Focused Power
description: Gain +1 Spell Attack

name: Action [Daily] : Restorance
description: Once per day, you restore power to either yourself or a conduit in an amount equal to 2d4 + your Spell Damage. The dice increases to 2d8 at level 7 and 3d10 at level 9.

name: Mind for Magic
description: Gain +1 Arcanum, +1 Resistance and +2 Psychic Mitigation

name: Reaction : Absorption
description: In response to a spell being channeled against you, use resistance as your defense check. On a failure, if the spell has a damage component, reduce that by half before applying mitigations. On a success, the spell does not affect you and you gain power equal to the amount used to channel the spell.

name: Essence of the Snake
description: Gain +1 Initiative and +1 Stealth

name: Venom Extractor
description: You gain +1 Resilience. As an action, you you can draw poison from yourself or an adjacent ally, giving them extra mitigation equal to your Resilience bonus modifier against the damage from the poison until it ends.

name: Disabling Venom
description: Gain +1 Alchemy. Poisons that you craft also cause the affected creature to gain Tier 1 Exhaustion.

name: Serpent Reflexes
description: Gain +1 Dodge

name: Reaction : Evade
description: In response to making a defense check, make an Initiative Check as well and use the higher of the two values

name: Free Action : Strike
description: You make a quick attack at a creature with a melee weapon with a 1d4 penalty. If the creature is poisoned, the attack has a 1d4 bonus instead.

name: Action : Coiled Lunge
description: You leap towards a creature within 2 units, making an attack with a melee weapon and adding your initiative bonus to the attack. If your attack misses, you return to your original position, otherwise you remain adjacent to the creature.

name: Beginner Striker
description: Gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with Unarmed Strikes. Gain a Fighting Stance.

name: Reaction : Flank
description: When an Allied Creature makes a Melee Attack against a target within your Melee Range, you can make an Attack against that same target with a 1d4 Bonus.

name: Increased Damage
description: Gain +1 Damage with Unarmed Strikes

name: Novice Striker
description: Gain +1 Attack with Unarmed Strikes and Learn a Fighting Stance from the Stance Table

name: Calloused Hands
description: Gain +1 Physical Mitigation

name: Bending Form
description: You can change your Stance at the start of each turn without a cost.

name: Journeyman Striker
description: Gain +1 Attack with Unarmed Strikes and gain access to the Attack of Opportunity Reaction

name: Action : Uppercut
description: You make a strong Unarmed Strike against a Creature, putting your full force into the blow and adding your Strength Bonus Modifier to the Damage. On a True Hit, the Strength Bonus is doubled.

name: Reaction : Counter
description: In response to being the Target of a Melee Attack, use your Athletics Skill in place of your Defense Check. If the Attack misses, the Creature must make an Athletics or Acrobatics Check against your Defense Check, or fall Prone.

name: Expert Striker
description: Gain Critical Hits and +1 Attack with Unarmed Attacks

name: Flawless Form
description: You gain the Flawless Defense Stance

name: Flowing Strikes
description: You gain the Flowing Strikes Stance

name: Master Striker
description: Gain Brutal Critical Hits with Unarmed Strikes and Gain +1 Attack with Unarmed Strikes

name: Advantageous Blows
description: Unarmed Strikes against Creatures that are Dazed or Stunned are automatically upgraded to Brutal Criticals

name: Action : Fatal Force
description: Roll a 1d4 and make a number of Unarmed Strikes against a Target equal to the result

name: Grandmaster Striker
description: Your Damage Die for Unarmed Strikes are upgraded to 2d6.
